articles.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia chief executive
articles.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO and shares tumbled 13%, with CFO Colette Kress appointed interim head of the AI chipmaking giant. The abrupt leadership change at the company powering much of the global AI infrastructure sent shockwaves through financial markets.

articles.title: 百度文心大模型再升级：ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 亮相，模型权重将于 11 月 25 日前正式开源
articles.summary: Baidu released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, the first post-trained version of its base model, featuring 280B parameters, 1M context support, and a commitment to full open-source release by November 25. The planned open-sourcing of a large-scale Chinese frontier model adds competitive pressure to the global open-source AI ecosystem.

articles.title: 阿里重磅官宣千问大模型 Qwen4：核心能力全线进化，千问 App 现已全面接入预览版
articles.summary: Alibaba announced Qwen4, the next generation of its Qwen large language model series, featuring a fully redesigned architecture with significant performance improvements across knowledge understanding and complex context handling, with a preview already integrated into the Qwen App. This positions Alibaba aggressively in the ongoing Chinese frontier model race alongside Baidu and Tencent's concurrent releases.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid spy, affair scandals
articles.summary: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned after the company's board investigated reports of two extramarital affairs, one involving an alleged Chinese spy and another with a direct subordinate. The departure of the central figure of the AI chip boom introduces major uncertainty for Nvidia and the broader AI infrastructure industry.

articles.title: Jensen Huang is gone. Will the AI industry pay the price?
articles.summary: Analysts warn that Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia could destabilize the financial and technological ecosystem that has underpinned the AI boom, given Nvidia's central role in supplying AI compute. The loss of Huang's leadership may slow deal-making, partnerships, and innovation cycles across the industry.

articles.title: 追赶国际AI第一梯队还需数年?张一鸣谈字节大模型研发目标
articles.summary: ByteDance CEO Zhang Yiming reportedly told internal AI teams that the company can compete with OpenAI and Anthropic but may need until 2029–2030 to fully close the gap, citing pretraining data scale as a key deficit. This candid internal assessment highlights the sustained competitive distance between Chinese and leading Western frontier AI labs and signals ByteDance's long-term investment commitment.

articles.title: 火山引擎推出Seedance2.5flash:生成速度翻倍，720P约0.99元/秒、较旗舰降低34%
articles.summary: Volcano Engine (ByteDance) launched Seedance 2.5 Flash, a cost-optimized video generation model offering double the speed of its flagship at ~0.99 RMB/second for 720P, a 34% price reduction. The move intensifies competition in AI video generation by targeting bulk content production use cases with aggressive pricing.

articles.title: 百度发布大模型交易平台“词元所”：宣称中立可信，打造大模型界的“证券交易所”
articles.summary: At Baidu World 2026, Robin Li launched 'Ciyuansuo,' a large model token trading platform modeled after a stock exchange, designed to solve trust and verification challenges enterprises face when selecting AI models. The platform introduces neutral third-party model vetting and credit rating mechanisms, potentially reshaping how enterprises discover and procure AI model services in China.

articles.title: 李彦宏:AI变革不只是技术革命，企业需要围绕智能体重构组织
articles.summary: At Baidu World 2026, Robin Li argued that AI represents not just a technological revolution but an organizational one, predicting that 'intelligent organizations' built around agents will become the defining competitive unit of the AI era. This framing—comparing AI infrastructure to industrial-era factories—reflects growing executive consensus that enterprise restructuring around AI agents is now a strategic imperative.

articles.title: 通芯智能完成数亿元种子轮及天使轮融资，龙芯海光背景团队研发AGI架构芯片 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: Tongxin Intelligence, a Chinese chip startup founded by veterans from Loongson and Hygon, has raised hundreds of millions of RMB in seed and angel funding to develop AGI-architecture chips. The funding highlights continued investor appetite for domestic Chinese AI chip development amid ongoing US export restrictions.

articles.title: 实测百度文心5.5 Flash Preview：审美依然在线，编程全力争先
articles.summary: Hands-on testing of Baidu's ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview shows strong performance in programming, 3D modeling, knowledge work, and content creation. The evaluation positions the model as a competitive entry in the Chinese frontier model landscape, particularly for developer-facing coding tasks.

articles.title: BAT新旗舰杀回第一阵营，压力来到字节这边
articles.summary: Baidu, Alibaba, and Tencent all released major model upgrades in the same week, reclaiming competitive standing in the Chinese AI frontier—while ByteDance's Seed 2.1 has gone nearly six months without an update. The simultaneous BAT resurgence intensifies pressure on ByteDance to accelerate its model development cadence.

articles.title: Meet Colette Kress, Nvidia’s New Interim CEO
articles.summary: Nvidia's longtime CFO Colette Kress has been named interim CEO following Jensen Huang's resignation, bringing deep financial and operational knowledge of the company. Her appointment provides short-term stability but leaves open questions about Nvidia's strategic direction in the intensely competitive AI chip market.

articles.title: Jensen Huang Ousted as Nvidia CEO
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was ousted by the board following reports of multiple affairs, one involving a woman suspected of spying for China, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO. The departure of Huang, the architect of Nvidia's AI chip dominance, creates significant uncertainty for the company and the broader AI industry that depends on its hardware.

articles.title: Nvidia Drama Triggers Difficult Search for Huang’s Successor
articles.summary: Nvidia has begun a difficult search for a successor to Jensen Huang, whose outsized personal role in shaping the company's AI strategy makes replacement uniquely challenging. Finding a leader capable of maintaining Nvidia's technological edge and industry relationships is seen as critical to its continued dominance.

articles.title: Trump Asked to Preserve Nvidia Documents by Senators
articles.summary: Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Coons asked the Trump administration to preserve all records related to Nvidia chip exports to China, amid concerns about diversion of advanced semiconductors. The request reflects intensifying congressional scrutiny over AI hardware export controls in the wake of the Huang scandal.

articles.title: China warns US not to use Nvidia scandal as pretext for tech curbs
articles.summary: China's government accused the US of fabricating espionage narratives that ultimately forced Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia. Beijing's response signals that it views the scandal as a geopolitically motivated effort to justify further restrictions on advanced chip technology.

articles.title: Anthropic Launches New Workplace Software, Sending Microsoft Shares Tanking - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic launched new workplace productivity software, directly competing with Microsoft's enterprise AI offerings and causing Microsoft shares to drop. The move signals Anthropic's ambition to expand beyond AI model development into the lucrative enterprise software market.

articles.title: Commerce Department Finalizing Long-Awaited AI Remote Access Rule - The Information
articles.summary: The US Commerce Department is finalizing a long-anticipated rule governing remote access to AI systems, which could have sweeping implications for how foreign entities interact with American AI infrastructure. The rule is part of broader efforts to prevent adversaries from leveraging US AI capabilities without direct chip exports.

articles.title: 单张消费级显卡跑出60FPS游戏世界:Matrix-Game4.0上线Reactor，浏览器里「边玩边生成
articles.summary: Kunlun Tech's Matrix-Game 4.0, a video game world model, has launched on the Reactor platform, enabling real-time interactive world generation at 60FPS/480p on a single consumer GPU (RTX 5090) via a browser. This marks a significant milestone in AI-generated interactive media, lowering the hardware barrier for real-time neural world simulation and opening it to global developers via SDK/API.

articles.title: 国产地震大模型“谛听”亮相：汇聚 2000 万数据集，让 AI 听懂地球“心跳”
articles.summary: China's domestically developed seismic AI model 'Diting' has been unveiled, trained on over 20 million high-quality seismic data records and capable of rapid earthquake reporting from single-station data. The model demonstrates AI's expanding role in scientific and disaster-prevention applications, particularly for earthquake monitoring and early warning.

articles.title: Chinese Workers Are Paying Their Own AI Bills to Stay Productive
articles.summary: Chinese workers are increasingly paying out of pocket for generative AI subscriptions and API costs to remain productive, as employers rarely reimburse these expenses, creating an unofficial personal AI tax on labor. This trend reveals a structural gap between AI adoption rates and corporate AI investment policies, with implications for labor costs and AI productivity diffusion in China.

articles.title: Alibaba’s Chip Unit Heads for Hong Kong With Cloud Still in the Way
articles.summary: Alibaba is planning to list its chip subsidiary T-Head on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange after eight years as an internal unit, though financial transparency remains limited due to most revenue flowing through Alibaba Cloud. The planned IPO reflects strategic moves by Chinese tech giants to independently surface AI hardware assets, though mixed financials may challenge investor confidence.

articles.title: 机器人泡沫在老股市场漏了气
articles.summary: Despite continued hot primary-market funding in embodied AI—with Xingchen Intelligence raising 1 billion RMB at a 15 billion RMB valuation—secondary market sellers of older shares are accepting 20–35% discounts, signaling investor caution around mass production timelines and order sustainability. This divergence between primary enthusiasm and secondary-market skepticism reflects maturing risk assessment in China's robotics investment cycle.

articles.title: 聊聊中国版MUSE：蚂蚁灵光2.0，支付宝，超级App的生态优势与挑战
articles.summary: Ant Group's Lingyuan 2.0, integrated within Alipay's super-app ecosystem, is positioned as China's answer to multimodal AI models like MUSE. The development highlights how Chinese tech giants are leveraging existing platform ecosystems to accelerate AI deployment and compete with Western foundation models.

articles.title: Who could replace Jensen Huang? A highly unscientific list of possible successors
articles.summary: Following Jensen Huang's resignation, analysts and observers are speculating about potential successors to lead Nvidia, noting the company lacks a formal succession plan. Leadership continuity is a critical concern given Nvidia's dominant role in supplying AI hardware globally.

articles.title: TSMC sees surging AI chip demand, highlights advanced packaging and physical AI opportunities
articles.summary: TSMC reported surging demand for AI chips and highlighted opportunities in advanced packaging and physical AI as key growth areas. This signals that AI hardware demand continues to outpace supply capacity, reinforcing TSMC's strategic position in the AI supply chain.

articles.title: The China chip self-sufficiency paradox: YMTC eyes 2027 IPO as restricted Nvidia GPUs reach Chinese universities
articles.summary: Chinese memory chipmaker YMTC is targeting a 2027 IPO as it pursues self-sufficiency, even as restricted Nvidia GPUs continue to reach Chinese universities through unclear channels. The situation illustrates the paradox of US export controls: stimulating Chinese domestic chip development while failing to fully cut off access to advanced foreign hardware.

articles.title: AI bottleneck shifts from compute to power; European supply chain sees power semiconductors as next shortage
articles.summary: Industry analysts report that the primary bottleneck for AI development is shifting from compute availability to power supply, with European semiconductor companies positioning power chips as the next critical shortage. This transition could reshape AI infrastructure investment priorities and create new supply chain vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Suspected Chinese spy at center of Jensen Huang affair surfaces in Beijing
articles.summary: Alice Huang, the woman at the center of the Jensen Huang affair and suspected spy scandal, has surfaced in Beijing amid widespread speculation about her background and relationship with the former Nvidia CEO. Her presence in China fuels ongoing geopolitical questions about potential technology transfer risks linked to the scandal.

articles.title: Google reworks TPU silicon into specialized systems for agents and security
articles.summary: Google has repurposed its TPU 8i and TPU 8t silicon into two specialized systems—TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx—targeting long-context AI agents and confidential inference workloads respectively. The move demonstrates Google's strategy of extending existing chip designs into niche high-value AI use cases rather than relying solely on new silicon generations.

articles.title: 腾讯辟谣裁员50%:计划将一半力量投入AI Native探索
articles.summary: Tencent's PR director publicly denied rumors of 50% layoffs, clarifying that the company's organizational changes are AI-driven transformation toward efficiency and innovation rather than cost-cutting. The denial underscores how major Chinese tech firms are reframing workforce restructuring as AI-native organizational evolution rather than retrenchment.

articles.title: 重构AI存储逻辑，长鑫携全场景内存矩阵亮相 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: CXMT (Changxin Memory Technologies) showcased a full-scenario memory matrix aimed at restructuring AI storage logic for diverse AI workloads. As AI model memory demands grow, domestic Chinese memory solutions from CXMT represent a strategic effort to reduce reliance on foreign HBM and DRAM suppliers.

articles.title: 库库，服务全球的中国AI样本 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: An EE Times China feature profiles a Chinese AI company serving global markets as a representative case study of China's AI export ambitions. This highlights the growing international footprint of Chinese AI products and the geopolitical implications of Chinese AI platforms scaling globally.

articles.title: 两城双子星，正在完成中国AI产业闭环。
articles.summary: An analysis examines how two Chinese cities are building complementary AI industrial ecosystems that together may complete China's domestic AI supply chain loop. This geographic clustering of AI talent, chips, models, and applications represents a structural approach to reducing China's dependence on foreign AI infrastructure.

articles.title: 35秒内阻断失控的智能体，OpenAI部署“控制室”系统
articles.summary: OpenAI has deployed a 'control room' system capable of blocking runaway AI agents within 35 seconds. This represents a concrete operational step toward AI containment and safety infrastructure, signaling growing industry focus on agentic AI risk mitigation.

articles.title: 大模型越狱攻击的内部模式
articles.summary: A new analysis examines the internal mechanics of jailbreak attacks on large language models, identifying structural patterns in how adversarial prompts bypass safety guardrails. Understanding these patterns is critical for improving model alignment and robustness against misuse.

articles.title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
articles.summary: OpenAI is committing $2 million to fund research into AI risks and opportunities specifically affecting children, including developing shared measurement tools. The investment signals growing industry attention to vulnerable user populations and may preempt regulatory pressure around child safety.

articles.title: The Nvidia Board Members Who Decided Jensen Huang’s Fate
articles.summary: A profile of the Nvidia board members who voted to oust Jensen Huang reveals a diverse group with backgrounds spanning fast food franchising to academic research. The composition of the board that made one of the most consequential decisions in AI industry history is drawing scrutiny.

articles.title: Singapore Bars Alice Huang From Entry After False-Document Probe
articles.summary: Singapore barred Alice Huang from entry after finding insufficient evidence to prosecute her following a false-document probe linked to the spy scandal that contributed to Jensen Huang's ouster. The case highlights the intersection of corporate espionage concerns and geopolitical tensions over AI chip access.

articles.title: Sex, spies and salaries shake up AI chipmakers
articles.summary: An in-depth account from Nikkei Asia and the Financial Times explores how sex scandals, espionage allegations, and executive pay disputes are reshaping the AI chip industry in Asia. The piece contextualizes the Nvidia CEO crisis within broader tensions in the Asian tech ecosystem.

articles.title: Can anything derail Anthropic’s IPO?
articles.summary: Anthropic is pressing forward with its IPO plans despite turbulence in the broader AI investment landscape. The move reflects confidence in Anthropic's market position but raises questions about valuation sustainability amid shifting sentiment toward AI stocks.

articles.title: 从辅助工具到实时协作者，AI超声设备开启端侧智能新范式 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: AI-powered ultrasound devices are evolving from passive assistive tools to real-time collaborative systems through edge-side intelligence. This development signals a new paradigm for on-device AI in medical imaging, reducing dependence on cloud connectivity and enabling smarter point-of-care diagnostics.

articles.title: AI时代下的整车开发流程 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: An EE Times China analysis examines how AI is transforming vehicle development workflows in the automotive industry. AI integration into the full vehicle development cycle represents a major application shift with implications for manufacturing efficiency and autonomous driving readiness.

articles.title: 新加坡三部门联合发布个人AI智能体安全须知
articles.summary: Three Singaporean government agencies jointly released safety guidelines for personal AI agents. This marks a significant regulatory move in Southeast Asia to address risks from autonomous AI systems at the consumer level.

articles.title: Claude累计已挖出3.8万个漏洞，然而管挖不管埋？
articles.summary: Anthropic's Claude has identified approximately 38,000 software vulnerabilities through automated security scanning, but the system reportedly does not assist in patching the flaws it discovers. This raises concerns about the responsible deployment of AI-powered cybersecurity tools and the gap between vulnerability detection and remediation.

articles.title: Data Centers Will Continue to Be Built, Despite Midterm Elections
articles.summary: Despite political headwinds from midterm elections slowing some approvals, major tech companies are pressing ahead with large-scale AI data center construction. The continued investment underscores the long-term commitment by hyperscalers to AI infrastructure regardless of short-term political fluctuations.

articles.title: Runway 开源 27B 世界动作模型 Praxis-1：登顶机器人权威榜单，全面支持 Apache 2.0 商业开源
articles.summary: Runway open-sourced Praxis-1, a 27B-parameter world action model for robotics under Apache 2.0, releasing full weights, inference, and fine-tuning code while topping a leading robotics benchmark. The open-source release of a top-performing embodied AI model intensifies competition in the robotics foundation model space and lowers barriers for commercial development.

articles.title: Holiday Extras is rethinking what it can build with Codex
articles.summary: Travel company Holiday Extras is using OpenAI's Codex to convert domain expertise from customer-facing staff into improved applications, boosting booking conversion rates. The case study illustrates how enterprise AI coding tools are enabling non-traditional software teams to build competitive digital products.

articles.title: Google and Samsung’s Android XR Smart Glasses Are Finally Here
articles.summary: Google and Samsung have launched Android XR smart glasses in partnership with eyewear brands Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, priced between $395 and $449. The release marks a significant step in bringing AI-integrated wearables to mainstream consumers and intensifies competition with Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses.

articles.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
articles.summary: A comprehensive guide to fine-tuning 3D generative AI models has been published, covering techniques and best practices for adapting these models to specific use cases. This contributes to the growing body of practical knowledge enabling wider deployment of 3D generation technology.

articles.title: Apple’s HomeView Tries Face Authentication Without FaceID
articles.summary: Apple's upcoming smart home device, HomeView, will use a new 'person recognition' technology for face-based authentication rather than the established FaceID system. The approach represents a novel application of computer vision for home security but introduces untested risks in a real-world deployment.

articles.title: Here’s How Google Says It’s Making Its Smart Glasses More Private
articles.summary: Google is emphasizing privacy as a key differentiator for its Android XR smart glasses compared to Meta's competing product. The positioning reflects how data handling has become a central competitive battleground in the emerging AI wearables market.

articles.title: Alex Karp Said He’s a ‘Progressive.’ OK! Here’s Some Other Stuff He’s Said Recently
articles.summary: Palantir CEO Alex Karp described himself as 'progressive' in a recent interview, but his public statements during the company's earnings call reveal a more hawkish and militaristic worldview. The contrast highlights tensions in how AI defense contractors position themselves politically while expanding government and military contracts.

articles.title: 张一鸣最新定调：字节有能力与Anthropic和OpenAI竞争，但追平前沿最早要到2029年
articles.summary: ByteDance co-founder Zhang Yiming stated the company believes it can compete with Anthropic and OpenAI, but acknowledged that reaching the frontier of AI technology will take until 2029 or 2030 at the earliest. This candid timeline signals the scale of the gap between Chinese and leading US AI labs, with significant implications for the global AI race.

articles.title: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang
articles.summary: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following reports of a second extramarital affair with a company executive, compounding an earlier scandal involving an affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. The potential ouster of Huang, who has led Nvidia for 33 years and been central to its AI chip dominance, could have significant implications for the company and the broader AI hardware industry.

articles.title: Nvidia Working With Outside Firm to Identify CEO Options
articles.summary: Nvidia's board is working with an outside firm to identify potential CEO replacements for Jensen Huang, following reports of multiple affairs including one with a suspected Chinese spy. The formal succession search marks a significant escalation in the leadership crisis at the world's most valuable AI chip company.

articles.title: 字节跳动计划数周内推出新款AI助手，布局智能体赛道
articles.summary: ByteDance plans to launch a new AI assistant similar to Meta's within weeks, further expanding its agentic AI offerings alongside its existing video generation strengths. The move reflects ByteDance's accelerating push to close the gap with leading US AI labs, with founder Zhang Yiming directly rallying AI teams.

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Valuations Fuel VC Fears of Startup Correction
articles.summary: OpenAI sought $30 billion in new capital at a $1.4 trillion valuation, raising concerns among VCs that sky-high AI startup valuations may be unsustainable and could trigger a broader correction. The divergence between OpenAI's and Anthropic's valuations is fueling anxiety about frothy AI funding conditions.

articles.title: Nvidia board meets on Jensen Huang's future as succession gap comes into focus
articles.summary: Nvidia's board has convened to discuss Jensen Huang's future as CEO amid the affairs scandal, with attention turning to the lack of a clear succession plan. The absence of an identified successor amplifies uncertainty for a company whose leadership has been deeply tied to its AI chip dominance.

articles.title: 平头哥分拆，难在阿里云
articles.summary: Alibaba's chip subsidiary Pingtouge (T-Head) is reportedly being spun off, with the central challenge being its deep dependency on Alibaba Cloud's resources and ecosystem. The spin-off raises questions about whether the chip unit can remain competitive in AI hardware independent of its parent cloud infrastructure.

articles.title: Alleged Chinese Spy at Center of Nvidia Firestorm Is in Beijing
articles.summary: The Chinese woman alleged to be a spy at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal has returned to Beijing, according to people familiar with the matter. Her departure to China further complicates the US national security investigation tied to Nvidia's leadership crisis.

articles.title: CoreWeave Plans to Raise at Least $4 Billion in High-Grade Loan
articles.summary: CoreWeave plans to raise at least $4 billion through an investment-grade loan after boosting its annual sales forecast. This signals continued investor confidence in AI infrastructure financing despite concerns about CoreWeave's heavy debt load.

articles.title: Huang Said to Have Had Affair With Nvidia Executive: NYT
articles.summary: The New York Times reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia's VP of Healthcare and a direct report. The revelation adds corporate governance pressure on the world's most valuable chip company at a critical moment for AI hardware supply.

articles.title: Meta’s Infrastructure Chief Is Leaving Amid Massive AI Buildout - The Information
articles.summary: Meta's infrastructure chief is departing the company amid its massive AI infrastructure expansion. The loss of a senior infrastructure leader during a critical AI buildout period could create execution risk for Meta's ambitions to compete at the frontier of AI.

articles.title: There Are Likely More Spies at AI Companies, Says Security Executive Lisa Thiergart - The Information
articles.summary: Security executive Lisa Thiergart warned that espionage at AI companies is likely more widespread than publicly known, citing the high strategic value of AI research. The statement underscores growing counterintelligence risks facing AI labs as geopolitical competition over AI intensifies.

articles.title: 灵光生态再扩容!新增微信 ClawBot、QQ机器人、瑞幸咖啡等六大连接器
articles.summary: China's Lingguan platform expanded its open ecosystem by adding six new connectors including WeChat ClawBot, QQ robot, Luckin Coffee, and others, bringing total external connections to 47. This signals growing integration of AI agent capabilities into everyday Chinese consumer apps, intensifying the AI assistant ecosystem competition domestically.

articles.title: AI短剧的造富幻觉和内容重构
articles.summary: AI-generated short dramas in China are gaining mainstream popularity, exemplified by the viral hit '持械入宋,' but the sector faces structural tensions between cost-reduction promises and content quality and governance challenges. The trend highlights both the disruptive commercial potential and the regulatory risks of AI-generated entertainment content.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO Risks Causing AI Correction, Selby Says
articles.summary: Venture capitalist Jack Selby warned that a potential Anthropic IPO could trigger a significant correction in AI-related stocks. The warning highlights market concerns about overvaluation in the AI sector and the systemic risk a high-profile IPO could pose to investor sentiment.

articles.title: Nvidia’s CEO Change Won’t Derail AI Trade: Pepperstone
articles.summary: Pepperstone research head Chris Weston argued that a potential CEO change at Nvidia would not derail the broader AI investment trade, as a successor would likely continue existing product roadmaps. The view reflects market confidence in Nvidia's institutional strength beyond any single leader, even amid significant leadership turmoil.

articles.title: AI jitters erupt after Democrats threaten data centre build-out
articles.summary: A Democratic midterm wave has prompted political threats against the AI data center construction boom, potentially stalling infrastructure buildout. This could significantly constrain the physical capacity needed to train and deploy large AI models.

articles.title: Taiwan proposes expanding protected technology list to 46 items
articles.summary: Taiwan has proposed expanding its list of protected technologies from the current number to 46 items, likely targeting advanced semiconductor and AI-related intellectual property. The move reflects Taiwan's effort to safeguard strategic tech assets amid intensifying geopolitical competition over chip technology.

articles.title: Jensen Huang now accused of affair with Nvidia executive who reported to him, alleged cover-up attempt
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is accused of an extramarital affair with a direct report and an alleged cover-up attempt, following a separate affair with a woman suspected of Chinese espionage ties. The dual scandals and governance failures place enormous pressure on the board to act and raise questions about leadership integrity at the apex of the AI supply chain.

articles.title: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
articles.summary: United Airlines has stated it will not allow personal AI agents to book flights on its platform, citing privacy and regulatory concerns. The decision illustrates significant real-world barriers to the adoption of autonomous AI agents in commercial transactions, even as the technology rapidly develops.

articles.title: 马斯克 xAI 面临多起集体诉讼：Grok 被指卷入儿童色情图像风波
articles.summary: Elon Musk's xAI is facing multiple class-action lawsuits in the United States alleging that its Grok chatbot was used to generate non-consensual intimate imagery, including child sexual abuse material. The case raises urgent questions about AI safety guardrails, liability for generative AI misuse, and the adequacy of content moderation in frontier AI systems.

articles.title: OpenAI第三季度营收突破100亿美元，环比增长近50%
articles.summary: OpenAI's Q3 revenue surpassed $10 billion for the first time, up nearly 50% from Q2's $6.7 billion, driven by strong demand and recent model launches. The rapid revenue growth and narrowing operating losses underscore OpenAI's strengthening market position, though the company remains unprofitable.

articles.title: OpenAI’s quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time
articles.summary: OpenAI's quarterly revenue has surpassed $10 billion for the first time, representing a nearly 50% jump from the $6.7 billion recorded in Q2. The milestone demonstrates rapid commercialization of AI products and strengthens OpenAI's position in ongoing fundraising and competitive dynamics.

articles.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2, an AI model that predicts how DNA sequence variations affect specific human cell types and disease mechanisms. The model represents a significant advance in computational biology, potentially accelerating drug discovery and understanding of genetic diseases.

articles.title: With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
articles.summary: UK-based AI chip startup Fractile raised a $720 million funding round, making it one of the best-funded challengers in purpose-built AI chip development. The raise underscores growing investor appetite for Nvidia alternatives and Europe's ambition to compete in the AI hardware race.

articles.title: Taiwan’s chipmaking giant TSMC to invest $1B in Anthropic, OpenAI
articles.summary: TSMC plans to invest $1 billion in both Anthropic and OpenAI, exemplifying the circular financing dynamic where AI chipmakers invest in AI model companies that in turn drive chip demand. The move deepens ties between hardware and AI software ecosystems while raising questions about supply chain concentration amid AI trade tensions.

articles.title: Anthropic’s IPO Is Said to Be Multiple Times Oversubscribed
articles.summary: Anthropic's IPO has attracted orders many times greater than the shares available, potentially making it the largest first-time share sale in history. The overwhelming demand reflects extraordinary investor confidence in frontier AI model companies at a pivotal moment for the industry.

articles.title: What’s Next for Anthropic’s Mega-IPO: Five Things to Watch
articles.summary: Anthropic's IPO, including a $26 billion private placement, is set to exceed SpaceX's record and could raise up to $90.4 billion when it prices on November 18, marking the first public listing of a frontier AI model company. This milestone will set a new benchmark for AI company valuations and could reshape how the market prices frontier AI risk and potential.

articles.title: 确认！阿里巴巴芯片公司平头哥已递交上市申请 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: Alibaba's chip subsidiary T-Head (平头哥) has officially filed an IPO application, confirming long-rumored plans to go public. This marks a significant step in China's push to develop domestic semiconductor capabilities independent of Western supply chains.

articles.title: A Startup Wants to Fight AI Bioweapons With AI
articles.summary: Startup Radical Numerics has developed an offline AI model capable of identifying both natural and AI-engineered pathogens, positioning it as a biosecurity tool against AI-generated bioweapons. The technology addresses a critical and emerging safety concern as generative AI lowers barriers to designing dangerous biological agents.

articles.title: Google DeepMind just mathematically verified key parts of Signal
articles.summary: Google DeepMind completed a four-week project to mathematically verify key components of the Signal encrypted messaging protocol using AI-assisted formal verification. The effort suggests AI could make formal software verification—historically expensive and slow—significantly more practical, with major implications for software security.

articles.title: UK chip start-up Fractile hits $7bn valuation
articles.summary: UK-based chip startup Fractile has reached a $7 billion valuation as it develops custom semiconductors designed specifically for AI workloads. The milestone underscores the growing investor interest in alternatives to Nvidia's GPU dominance, particularly from European startups.

articles.title: Meta is losing its longtime head of  infrastructure
articles.summary: Santosh Janardhan, Meta's longtime head of infrastructure who joined the company in 2009, is stepping down from his role. His departure is notable given Meta's massive ongoing investment in AI infrastructure and data centers.

articles.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
articles.summary: CoreWeave is restructuring its financing by requiring customer prepayments, borrowing against individual contracts, and offering shorter-term deals at higher prices to fund its AI cloud growth. The strategy reveals the financial pressures facing AI infrastructure companies trying to scale rapidly amid capital-intensive GPU deployments.

articles.title: Congress to call Jensen Huang in to answer for alleged Chinese spy affair
articles.summary: House Republicans are calling Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang for a closed-door briefing regarding his relationship with a woman alleged to be a Chinese intelligence operative, with a deadline set for Wednesday. The congressional inquiry signals that the affair is being treated as a potential national security concern given Huang's central role in global AI chip supply.

articles.title: Trump Officials Clashed Over Megaspeed, Firm at Heart of Nvidia Affair
articles.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick clashed over why the administration failed to restrict advanced chip sales to Megaspeed, the firm at the center of the Nvidia-China scandal. The internal rift reveals significant policy disagreement within the Trump administration over export controls on AI hardware to China.

articles.title: AI has proved that a theory underpinning fundamental physics is trustworthy
articles.summary: AI has validated a foundational theory in fundamental physics, though key insights are attributed to human physicists who guided the process. This demonstrates AI's growing utility as a research tool in hard sciences, potentially accelerating breakthroughs in theoretical physics.

articles.title: Rubenstein on the Anthropic IPO, Nvidia CEO Scandal
articles.summary: Carlyle Group co-Chairman David Rubenstein projected Anthropic's IPO valuation could reach $1.3 trillion and expressed confidence that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will retain his position despite the ongoing scandal. The commentary underscores strong investor confidence in frontier AI companies even amid corporate governance controversies.

articles.title: Nvidia China Scandal Demands Answers, Says Congressman
articles.summary: Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi called for congressional testimony from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over his reported relationship with a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence, raising the possibility of a subpoena. The congressman also called for a review of Nvidia's China export licenses, signaling potential legislative action that could tighten AI chip export policy.

articles.title: Google Adds Gemini Voice AI Assistant to Apple CarPlay
articles.summary: Google is integrating its Gemini AI voice assistant into Apple's CarPlay system, giving drivers broader access to the assistant directly from their vehicles. This expansion marks a significant step in embedding large language model-based assistants into everyday mobility infrastructure.

articles.title: United Blocks AI Agents From Booking Flights Ahead of Holidays
articles.summary: United Airlines is blocking third-party AI agents from booking flights or accessing customer accounts ahead of the holiday travel season, citing privacy concerns. The move highlights growing corporate resistance to autonomous AI agents operating in sensitive commercial environments, with potential implications for the agentic AI industry.

articles.title: Odd Lots: The AI Trade Shrugs Off a Blue Wave and a Tech Scandal
articles.summary: Despite a Democratic electoral sweep raising questions about AI policy and the Nvidia CEO scandal rattling sentiment, markets are rallying ahead of the anticipated Anthropic IPO. The resilience of AI-related equities suggests investor confidence in long-term AI growth outweighs near-term political and governance risks.

articles.title: AI Optimism Reignites the Tech Trade
articles.summary: CoreWeave's upbeat earnings forecast and Anthropic's blockbuster IPO are reigniting bullish sentiment across the AI and tech trade, even as the Nvidia scandal creates political uncertainty. The combined signals suggest the market views AI infrastructure and model development as structurally strong despite governance headwinds.

articles.title: Hawley backs nationwide data center moratorium
articles.summary: Senator Josh Hawley is joining progressive Democrats in backing a nationwide moratorium on new data center construction until Congress ensures taxpayers are protected from higher utility bills. The bipartisan push signals that AI infrastructure buildout is becoming a flashpoint for energy cost and regulatory debates at the federal level.

articles.title: SpaceX develops its own ‘Kessel’ rack-scale system featuring 72 Nvidia Rubin GPUs for data centers in space, report claims
articles.summary: SpaceX is reportedly developing a 'Kessel' rack-scale computing system featuring 72 Nvidia Rubin GPUs built on an 84-layer PCB midplane, intended for space-based data centers. The development points to an emerging frontier for AI compute infrastructure in orbit, with significant implications for both the AI hardware and space industries.

articles.title: Softbank loses $3.7 billion on canceled AI data center gas turbine orders days after denying Elon Musk’s claim it was defaulting
articles.summary: SoftBank has pulled out of gas turbine orders worth $3.7 billion after overestimating how many power units it would need for its AI data center expansion. The cancellation reveals the volatility and miscalculation risks in AI infrastructure planning, with major financial consequences for companies scaling aggressively.

articles.title: Why the data center you dread might never even be built
articles.summary: Many announced AI data center projects face serious obstacles including local community opposition, permitting delays, and electricity shortages, with a large share potentially never being built. This infrastructure bottleneck could constrain the pace of AI scaling and shift competitive advantages toward players who already have operational capacity.

articles.title: China’s Nvidia Honeypot Isn’t Surprising. Jensen Huang Fell for It Anyway
articles.summary: Analysis examines how Jensen Huang, despite being the world's most powerful AI executive, fell victim to China's well-documented sexpionage intelligence tactics. The piece raises concerns about the vulnerability of top tech leaders to foreign intelligence operations targeting the AI industry.

articles.title: Big Walk used AI to fix a bug. Now the indie gaming world is having a reckoning.
articles.summary: Indie game studio Big Walk's use of AI to fix a bug sparked a broader reckoning in the independent gaming community, with many Independent Games Festival judges declaring any AI-generated code disqualifying. The controversy reflects deepening tensions over AI's role in creative industries and how communities are setting their own ethical standards ahead of formal regulation.

articles.title: Token Pooling-Aware Training for Multi-Vector Embedding Models
articles.summary: A research paper introduces token pooling-aware training techniques for multi-vector embedding models, aiming to improve efficiency and performance in dense retrieval systems. articles.summary: Adobe revealed experimental AI features at its Max conference, including tools that convert photos into explorable 3D scenes, enable designers to create AI characters through conversation, and simplify photo editing via copy-paste workflows. These tools signal Adobe's aggressive expansion of generative AI into creative professional workflows.

articles.title: Is Jensen Huang’s bad behavior more commonplace than it seems?

articles.summary: Databricks CEO Ali Ghodsi uses a revised version of the company's Genie AI agent to get unfiltered internal feedback about company operations that employees are unlikely to share directly. The use case highlights a growing trend of executives deploying AI agents for organizational intelligence and transparency at scale.

articles.title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
articles.summary: Startup Plurai is applying end-to-end training approaches borrowed from autonomous vehicle development to make AI agents more reliable in unpredictable real-world environments. The methodology could address one of the core reliability challenges limiting enterprise adoption of agentic AI systems.

articles.title: IBM to offer access to a dual-processor quantum system in 2027
articles.summary: IBM announced plans to offer access to a dual-processor quantum system linking two 520-qubit chips by 2027, marking a step toward more powerful quantum computing architectures. articles.summary: Elon Musk and other Silicon Valley figures publicly defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, framing his relationship with an alleged Chinese spy as a personal failing rather than a national security issue. articles.title: This Trader Raised Alarm About Nvidia’s China Entanglements Months Ago
articles.summary: Short seller Christian Lamarco, 31, publicly warned about financial and personal problems at Nvidia as early as May, months before the scandal became mainstream news. articles.title: JioStar’s chief architect on AI discovery at 500M-user scale
articles.summary: JioStar's chief architect Vijay Seshadri shared lessons on deploying AI recommendation and discovery systems at a 500-million-user scale, covering evaluation frameworks and production guardrails. The case study offers rare insight into operationalizing AI at massive consumer scale in a developing market.

articles.title: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps
articles.summary: Google launched an experimental AI tool called Tabletop that lets users vibe-code custom collaborative apps for coordinating with family and friends by describing what they want. articles.title: I Saw the Future of Robotics in a Virtual Duck That Chases My Cat
articles.summary: A writer used an OpenAI model to program a Microduck robot to perform tasks like waddling and interacting with a cat, illustrating how AI is lowering the barrier to consumer robotics programming. The anecdote reflects the growing accessibility of AI-powered robotics beyond industrial or research settings.

Qwen4 features major advances in knowledge understanding, world perception, coding, and agentic capabilities, deepening Alibaba's competition in the foundation model market.

articles.title: Nvidia loses ground in Washington chip fight after CEO spy scandal

The controversy could accelerate restrictions that would significantly limit Nvidia's ability to sell advanced chips in key overseas markets.

This divergence in usage patterns has significant implications for the long-term commercial and societal value generated by AI in each market.

articles.summary: ByteDance is preparing to release a Muse-like AI agent in the coming weeks, aiming to close the capability gap with leading US AI labs within three years. The milestone signals a shift in how AI assistants are evaluated—from conversation counts toward the volume and complexity of tasks autonomously managed on users' behalf.

articles.title: 国产文生图模型首度登顶全球第一！ArtArk 斩获 SuperCLUE 榜首：图文一致性唯一斩获满分

articles.title: Shengshu’s First AI Feature Film Misses the Mark as Its Hong Kong IPO Nears
articles.summary: China's first AI-assisted theatrical film from Shengshu Technology underperformed at the box office as the company approaches a Hong Kong IPO, raising investor concerns about its ability to monetize AI video generation technology. The case highlights the gap between technical capabilities in controllable AI video and commercial viability in the entertainment market.

articles.title: 中国AI，越来越烧钱

articles.title: Why Is It So Hard to Teach A.I. Agents to Behave? Researchers Have a Theory.
articles.summary: Researchers are exploring why training AI agents to reliably follow human direction without deception or resistance remains fundamentally difficult, proposing new theoretical frameworks for the problem. This work is central to AI alignment and the safe deployment of autonomous AI systems.

articles.title: US and China should stay clear-eyed on AI cooperation and competition, Bessent says - Reuters
articles.summary: US Treasury Secretary Bessent called for the US and China to maintain clear-eyed perspectives on both AI cooperation and competition, signaling a nuanced diplomatic stance on the technology rivalry. The statement reflects growing recognition that AI governance requires balancing competitive pressures with potential areas for bilateral engagement.

articles.title: Germany's Helsing to unveil AI-based military software as a rival to Palantir - Reuters

articles.title: Anthropic’s Mythos AI Looking for Cyber Flaws in Energy Systems
articles.summary: Anthropic's Mythos AI tool is being used by power companies to detect cybersecurity vulnerabilities in critical energy infrastructure, following months of lobbying for access to advanced AI models. articles.summary: AI pioneer and investor Kai-Fu Lee has publicly questioned whether soaring trillion-dollar AI valuations are justified, citing risks from circular funding structures and the pressure from cheaper Chinese and open-source models. articles.title: Anthropic IPO Demand Surges as AI Trade Roars Back

articles.title: Banks seek to rein in soaring AI agent costs, McKinsey says - Reuters

articles.title: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic has set its IPO price range at $70–$78 per share, targeting a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, which would make it one of the largest IPOs ever. The valuation reflects enormous investor confidence in frontier AI but also comes in below some earlier expectations, signaling measured market sentiment.

articles.title: DeepMind reveals Gemini Robotics 2.5 and open safety benchmark "ASIMOV-jailbreak"
articles.summary: Google DeepMind revealed Gemini Robotics 2.5, achieving up to twice the success rate on certain tasks compared to its predecessor, alongside an open safety benchmark called 'ASIMOV-jailbreak' for evaluating robotic AI safety. The dual release advances both robotic AI capability and the nascent field of robot safety evaluation.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Giant IPO Will Tie It Closer to Nvidia
articles.summary: Nvidia plans to invest $10 billion in Anthropic as part of Anthropic's upcoming IPO, the largest single financial commitment from a major tech firm in the deal. The investment would tightly link the dominant AI chip maker with a leading foundation model company, reshaping competitive dynamics in the AI ecosystem.

articles.title: Trump says FBI probing Nvidia CEO Huang as China controversy deepens - Reuters
articles.summary: President Trump stated the FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in connection with his relationship with a woman identified as a Chinese intelligence asset. The federal probe elevates the scandal from a corporate governance issue to a national security matter with potential legal consequences.

articles.title: MiniMax开源H3-Image:10秒生成16MP图像，价格仅同档工具50%–70%
articles.summary: MiniMax released its open-weight H3-Image model on November 10, capable of generating 16MP 4K images in under 10 seconds—five times faster than mainstream alternatives—at 50–70% of competitor pricing. The model's combination of speed, quality, and open access significantly lowers the barrier for high-resolution image generation and challenges proprietary incumbents.

articles.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 accelerates real-world general dexterity
articles.summary: Google has released Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model, designed to improve robot dexterity, reliability, and safety in real-world tasks. The advancement accelerates the integration of frontier AI reasoning into physical robotics systems, a key battleground for general-purpose AI.

articles.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
articles.summary: Google has released Gemini 4 Carbon to the general public, touting it as its strongest model yet with an agent 'swarm' feature and cybersecurity capabilities competitive with Anthropic and OpenAI. The release marks a significant escalation in the frontier model race and introduces multi-agent coordination as a key differentiator.

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
articles.summary: New York's AI safety law has taken effect, requiring major AI developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face financial penalties. The regulation represents one of the most concrete state-level AI oversight frameworks in the US, setting a precedent that could influence national policy.

articles.title: Amazon and Google Will See Big Paydays from Anthropic IPO
articles.summary: Amazon and Google, as Anthropic's largest investors, stand to gain hundreds of billions of dollars in value if Anthropic's anticipated IPO proceeds. The payoff would validate the hyperscalers' strategy of making large early bets on frontier AI labs to secure both financial returns and strategic cloud partnerships.

articles.title: Alibaba AI chip unit T-Head files for Hong Kong IPO - Reuters
articles.summary: Alibaba's AI chip unit T-Head has filed for an IPO on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, seeking to raise capital to compete in the global AI semiconductor market. The listing signals China's push to develop independent AI chip capabilities amid ongoing U.S. export restrictions.

articles.title: OpenAI Revenue Jumps to $10 Billion in Third Quarter Amid Growing Losses - The Information
articles.summary: OpenAI's revenue surged to $10 billion in the third quarter, though losses also continued to grow at a significant pace. The figures underscore OpenAI's rapid commercial traction while highlighting the enormous costs of competing at the frontier of AI development.

articles.title: Anthropic Discloses Over $10 Billion in New Deals with Microsoft, Google; Says Lambda Deal May Be Cancelled - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic has disclosed over $10 billion in new cloud computing deals with Microsoft and Google, while revealing that a previously announced deal with Lambda may be cancelled. These partnerships cement Anthropic's deep ties with the two dominant cloud providers and reduce its dependence on independent GPU cloud operators.

articles.title: Anthropic Sets Lower than Expected Valuation, Seeks to Raise $90 Billion in IPO - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic is seeking to raise funds at a valuation of approximately $90 billion in its IPO, with early reports suggesting this is lower than some investor expectations. The offering will be a key test of public market appetite for high-growth, pre-profitability AI companies.

articles.title: TSMC plans investments in Anthropic, OpenAI; sets up investment firm to expand semiconductor strategy
articles.summary: TSMC is planning investments in both Anthropic and OpenAI and is establishing a dedicated investment firm to expand its strategic role in the AI ecosystem beyond chip manufacturing. This move positions the world's leading chipmaker as an active stakeholder in frontier AI, deepening the hardware-software integration across the AI supply chain.

articles.title: Alice Huang reportedly instrumental in securing over $7.5 billion of Nvidia AI GPU imports during three-year relationship with Jensen Huang
articles.summary: Alice Huang, the executive alleged to be a Chinese spy in a relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, reportedly played a key role in facilitating over $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia GPU imports for Chinese companies over three years. The report raises serious national security concerns about whether U.S. export controls on advanced AI chips were effectively circumvented through personal relationships at the executive level.

articles.title: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched an AI-powered office productivity suite, expanding beyond its enterprise and coding tools to compete more directly with OpenAI and other frontier labs in workplace applications. The move signals Anthropic's ambition to broaden its commercial footprint as it approaches its IPO.

articles.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
articles.summary: All seven Anthropic co-founders plan to sell identical share allocations in the company's IPO, each netting approximately $250 million while collectively retaining control of the company. The structured insider sale reflects both the founders' confidence in the company's long-term trajectory and their desire to maintain governance control post-IPO.

articles.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
articles.summary: Startup PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a longstanding fundamental question in quantum computing, aiming to commercialize AI-driven scientific discovery. This signals a growing market for AI applied to hard scientific problems, potentially accelerating research timelines across disciplines.

articles.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
articles.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings, an AI assistant that joins live workplace calls to draft plans, create timelines, answer questions, and retrieve information from connected work apps in real time. The product deepens Claude's integration into enterprise workflows, intensifying competition with Microsoft Copilot and Google's workplace AI tools.

articles.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
articles.summary: Google unveiled two new specialized tensor processing units (TPUs) designed for confidential model training and higher memory capacity, broadening its AI hardware portfolio. This expands Google's ability to serve diverse enterprise AI workloads and reduces reliance on third-party chip suppliers.

articles.title: AI training startup Mercor valued at $20 billion in latest funding round - Reuters
articles.summary: AI training data startup Mercor has been valued at $20 billion in its latest funding round, reflecting surging investor demand for infrastructure supporting AI model training. The valuation underscores how ancillary AI services, particularly data and human feedback pipelines, are attracting massive capital.

articles.title: CoreWeave Quiets Doubts About AI Business With Upbeat Outlook
articles.summary: AI cloud computing provider CoreWeave delivered a strong quarterly report with upbeat forward guidance, easing investor fears about its heavily debt-financed business model and slowing AI infrastructure demand. The results suggest that enterprise demand for AI compute remains robust despite broader data center industry headwinds.

articles.title: Nvidia Board Members Tap Wachtell’s Kim for Huang Probe
articles.summary: Nvidia's independent board members have hired a former top federal prosecutor from law firm Wachtell to lead an internal investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's ties to a suspected Chinese intelligence operative. articles.title: Anthropic Investors Shop IPO Shares Early, and at a Big Premium
articles.summary: Some early Anthropic investors are offering portions of their IPO share allocations to new investors at a significant premium ahead of what could be a record-breaking public listing. articles.title: CoreWeave plans multibillion-dollar chip-backed debt deal
articles.summary: CoreWeave is pursuing a multibillion-dollar asset-backed debt deal, using its chip infrastructure as collateral and leveraging customer pre-payments to secure financing. articles.title: Nvidia hires former US prosecutor at Wachtell to lead Jensen Huang probe
articles.summary: Nvidia has retained prominent law firm Wachtell Lipton, hiring a former federal prosecutor, to lead an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's alleged romantic relationship with an individual accused of being a Chinese spy. articles.title: Goldman Sachs expects Anthropic revenue to exceed $600bn by 2030
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs projects Anthropic's revenue will exceed $600 billion by 2030, representing a roughly 130-fold increase from current levels, with the company becoming cash-flow positive by decade's end. articles.title: Trahan crafting AI safety bill with narrower state preemption
articles.summary: Congresswoman Trahan is drafting an AI safety bill that would preempt state AI regulations only in a narrower set of circumstances, a shift from broader federal preemption proposals. This approach reflects ongoing political tensions between federal AI oversight and states' rights to regulate AI, particularly in a potentially Democrat-controlled Congress.

articles.title: Google Grapples With AI’s Hit to Its Ads Juggernaut - The Information
articles.summary: Google is grappling with the impact of AI-powered search and competitors on its core advertising business, as AI-generated answers reduce user clicks on traditional search ads. This represents a structural threat to Google's primary revenue engine and signals a broader industry shift in how AI is reshaping digital advertising economics.

articles.title: Microsoft lobbies against potential ban on Chinese optical networking gear for AI data centers as FCC mulls restricting imports
articles.summary: Microsoft is lobbying against a potential FCC ban on Chinese-made optical networking components used in AI data centers, arguing the restrictions could disrupt critical infrastructure buildouts. articles.title: 2026，AI应用的钱都流向了哪里？

articles.summary: Wearable health company Oura is acquiring AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625 million, weeks after postponing its own IPO due to market uncertainty. articles.summary: Stifel announced a partnership with Anthropic to deploy Claude-based tools aimed at helping financial advisers organize work and communicate with clients more effectively, without replacing human judgment. articles.summary: An in-depth profile examines Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's unique management style and the existential risks the company faces if he were to depart, given his central role in its extraordinary growth. articles.title: CoreWeave Earnings Top Estimates, Boosts Annual Forecast
articles.summary: CoreWeave reported earnings that beat analyst estimates and raised its annual revenue forecast, signaling strong demand for AI compute infrastructure. articles.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department delayed adding Megaspeed, a company connected to an alleged Chinese spy who reportedly had a relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, to its trade entity blacklist. articles.summary: An investigative report traces the career and connections of Alice Huang, the executive alleged to be a Chinese spy who had a relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, revealing ties to individuals with histories of regulatory violations. articles.title: OpenAI Acquires AI Travel Agent Odessia - The Information
articles.summary: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, an AI-powered travel agent startup, expanding its push into agentic applications beyond its core language model products. The acquisition signals OpenAI's ambition to build end-to-end AI products in high-value consumer verticals such as travel.

articles.title: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
articles.summary: Joint research from OpenAI and Upwork finds that demand for freelance work is shifting, with AI-related projects commanding larger budgets and more hours while requiring new skill combinations. The findings provide early empirical evidence of how AI is restructuring labor markets and freelance economies.

articles.title: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
articles.summary: An analysis argues that the US leads the global AI race but that espionage targeting of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang—given his central role in AI chip supply—represents a significant vulnerability. articles.summary: eBay has apparently blocked third-party AI agents, including Meta's Muse, from browsing its platform, cutting off automated AI-driven curation of marketplace listings. articles.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
articles.summary: OpenAI is rolling out new business profiles for ChatGPT to help companies surface their products and services through the AI interface, positioning ChatGPT as a consumer discovery engine. articles.summary: Reports detail a timeline of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with Alice Huang, a woman identified by U.S. intelligence as a Chinese asset, raising national security concerns. articles.title: Ring, known for its doorbell cameras, launches a home security drone and an enterprise security robot
articles.summary: Amazon-owned Ring announced a home security drone and an enterprise security robot, extending its camera-based security brand into autonomous robotics. The move positions Amazon in a growing market for AI-powered physical security and autonomous patrol systems.

articles.title: Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere are making it easier to remove things
articles.summary: Adobe is adding new generative AI and automated editing features to Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere, including automatic object and blemish removal, as part of its expanded Firefly AI platform. articles.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
articles.summary: Meta's AI assistant Muse is now available on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS, allowing users to interact via voice, text, or dictation directly from their smartwatch. The expansion onto wearables marks a push to embed AI assistants more deeply into everyday consumer devices.

articles.title: Quanta Computer vice chairman sees no slowdown in US AI infrastructure investment after midterms
articles.summary: Quanta Computer's vice chairman stated he sees no signs of a slowdown in U.S. AI infrastructure investment following the midterm elections, suggesting political transitions are not dampening enterprise hardware spending. articles.title: Pay for Hugging Face Hub with your Google Cloud Account
articles.summary: Hugging Face now allows users to pay for Hub services using their Google Cloud account, deepening the integration between the two platforms. articles.title: Decision Models in Hugging Face
articles.summary: Hugging Face has introduced Decision Models as a new model category on its Hub platform. This expands the Hub's scope beyond generative AI into reinforcement learning and decision-making systems, broadening its relevance for agentic and control applications.

articles.title: The indie game community is in disarray over AI and Big Walk
articles.summary: Some Independent Games Festival jurors announced they would not vote for games using generative AI in any capacity, prompted by indie hit Big Walk disclosing limited AI use during development. articles.title: What happens to mathematics when AI becomes an oracle?
articles.summary: Mathematician Steven Strogatz, in discussing his new book, explores how AI acting as an oracle in mathematics could change the nature of proof, understanding, and discovery in the field. articles.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
articles.summary: Australian law firm Gilbert + Tobin is rethinking its business model by integrating AI into legal workflows, as discussed by its CEO Sam Nickless.
