articles.title: OpenAI Completes $11 Billion Portion of Funding at $1.25 Trillion Value
articles.summary: OpenAI has closed on $11 billion in new funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation, with the full round potentially reaching $20 billion. This makes OpenAI one of the most valuable companies in the world and dramatically expands its resources for model development and infrastructure.

articles.title: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
articles.summary: China's Ministry of State Security recruited Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and gather intelligence on advanced American AI chips, potentially to influence chip export policy. The case illustrates the escalating use of espionage as a tool in the US-China competition over AI semiconductor access.

articles.title: AI boom turns chip packaging into the next battleground for semiconductors - Reuters
articles.summary: The AI-driven chip boom is turning advanced chip packaging technology into a major new competitive battleground in the semiconductor industry. As leading-edge packaging becomes critical to AI chip performance, companies and nations are racing to secure dominance in this previously overlooked manufacturing segment.

articles.title: Neocloud Groq Aims to Double Value to $8 Billion Amid AI Selloff
articles.summary: AI inference neocloud Groq is seeking to double its valuation to approximately $8 billion in roughly three months, while criticizing competitors for excessive reliance on debt financing. The move reflects continued investor interest in AI infrastructure plays even amid broader market volatility.

articles.title: Anthropic to press ahead with IPO targeting $1.5tn valuation
articles.summary: Anthropic is pressing ahead with an IPO targeting a $1.5 trillion valuation, aiming to list before Thanksgiving despite a significant downturn in tech markets. The move would make Anthropic's public offering one of the largest AI-related listings ever, testing investor appetite during a turbulent market period.

articles.title: TSMC Weighs Making Advanced Memory Chips to Capture More AI Spending - The Information
articles.summary: TSMC is weighing entry into advanced memory chip manufacturing to capture a larger share of AI-driven semiconductor spending. This potential expansion would intensify competition in the high-bandwidth memory market critical to AI accelerator performance.

articles.title: Anthropic’s R&D Speed May Have Doubled Due to AI, Researchers Find - The Information
articles.summary: Researchers have found that Anthropic's use of AI tools may have doubled its internal R&D speed, according to The Information. This finding provides concrete evidence that AI is significantly accelerating the pace of AI research itself, with major implications for the broader competitive landscape.

articles.title: 面对面｜熊友军：机器人跑跳舞蹈，如何落地为实际价值？
articles.summary: Chinese robotics expert Xiong Youjun discusses how robots capable of running, jumping, and dancing can be translated into real-world practical value. This highlights the ongoing challenge of bridging advanced robotics demonstrations with viable commercial applications in the AI hardware space.

articles.title: Ex-OpenAI employee accused of spying pleads not guilty
articles.summary: Former OpenAI employee Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi Arabian national arrested last month on espionage charges, has pleaded not guilty after a bug was discovered in the company's office. The case raises concerns about insider threats and foreign intelligence operations targeting leading AI laboratories.

articles.title: All the latest updates on AI data centers
articles.summary: A roundup of ongoing developments around AI data centers covers the massive infrastructure buildout by tech companies and the resulting conflicts over energy consumption, utility costs, and community impact. This infrastructure race is a critical bottleneck shaping the pace and geography of AI development globally.

articles.title: Anthropic Launches Personal Finance Feature for Claude - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched a personal finance feature for its Claude AI assistant, expanding the chatbot's capabilities into consumer financial management. This move signals Anthropic's push into specialized consumer applications to diversify revenue beyond enterprise and API customers.

articles.title: Nvidia hardware worth $11.4M vanished between Oakland and Texas
articles.summary: Six pallets of Nvidia hardware valued at $11.4 million disappeared during shipment between Oakland and Texas, with no arrests made two months after the incident. The theft highlights physical supply chain vulnerabilities for high-value AI chips amid surging global demand.

articles.title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers
articles.summary: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis suffered a 'multifront cyberattack' in which hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers, with the attack involving AI agents and an on-path data interception. The incident signals a troubling escalation in AI-assisted cyberattacks targeting sensitive financial and intelligence infrastructure.

articles.title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
articles.summary: An experiment testing AI models' hacking capabilities found that Chinese open-source models DeepSeek and GLM performed nearly as well as OpenAI's advanced, non-public cyber model in breaking into simulated networks. The findings raise serious national security concerns about the accessibility of powerful AI-enabled offensive cyber tools.

articles.title: GPT-6.2 Astra开启灰测！Claude Mythos 5.5同日曝光
articles.summary: Reports indicate GPT-6.2 'Astra' has entered gray testing, with Anthropic's Claude 'Mythos 5.5' also leaked on the same day. The simultaneous emergence of next-generation models from both OpenAI and Anthropic signals intensifying competition at the frontier of large language model development.

articles.title: GPT周报｜中国台湾拟进一步限制大陆半导体出口；美国AI基建股普遍下跌；中国移动2027年计划算力投资1000亿元
articles.summary: A weekly AI briefing covers Taiwan's moves to further restrict semiconductor exports to mainland China, declining U.S. AI infrastructure stocks, and China Mobile's plan to invest 100 billion yuan in computing power by 2027. These developments collectively highlight the ongoing geopolitical contest over AI hardware and infrastructure dominance.

articles.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark designed to evaluate how well AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science tasks such as interpreting raw experimental data. The benchmark provides a structured tool for measuring AI capability in applied biological research settings, which is critical for assessing real-world scientific utility.

articles.title: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry
articles.summary: Democrats' sweeping midterm victories are expected to reshape AI and tech policy, with voters approving restrictions on data center development in 40 out of 41 ballot measures. The results suggest a coming era of tighter regulatory and community-level opposition to AI infrastructure expansion in the United States.

articles.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
articles.summary: Corporate spending data from Ramp shows AI expenditure has plateaued even as usage grows, driven by price cuts and cost controls among major enterprise customers, complicating growth narratives ahead of Anthropic's IPO. This divergence between usage and revenue growth raises questions about the sustainability of AI companies' high valuations.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned by Congress over Chinese espionage concerns
articles.summary: Congress has summoned Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify over concerns about his alleged ties to a Chinese intelligence asset and potential espionage risks. The development heightens scrutiny of the semiconductor industry's connections to China at a critical moment in the AI chip geopolitical rivalry.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO Investors Weigh Valuation as Low as $1.2 Trillion
articles.summary: Anthropic's IPO valuation expectations have dropped, with prospective investors now considering figures as low as $1.2 trillion amid a post-election market selloff affecting tech stocks. The recalibration signals growing investor caution about AI company valuations in a shifting political and market environment.

articles.title: Microsoft Winding Down Oracle Deal to Rent AI Cloud Capacity
articles.summary: Microsoft is winding down an agreement to rent AI computing capacity from Oracle, as part of a broader reassessment of its cloud partnership spending. The move suggests Microsoft is consolidating or redirecting its AI infrastructure strategy, with potential implications for Oracle's AI business.

articles.title: TSMC Mulls Making Advanced AI Memory Chips, Information Says
articles.summary: TSMC is reportedly considering expanding into advanced AI memory chip manufacturing, which would give the world's largest chipmaker an even greater foothold in the AI hardware supply chain. The move could disrupt existing memory chip players and further consolidate TSMC's strategic importance to the global AI industry.

articles.title: Nvidia tightens tracking of AI GPUs in Southeast Asia as Chinese chip smuggling draws scrutiny, report claims
articles.summary: Nvidia is requiring Southeast Asian cloud partners to enroll in its Fleet Intelligence GPU tracking program to gain greater visibility into where its AI chips are deployed, amid U.S. scrutiny over suspected smuggling of chips into China. The move underscores how export control enforcement is pushing chipmakers to build active compliance infrastructure into their partner ecosystems.

articles.title: Big Tech lost big in the 2026 election
articles.summary: In the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, voters overwhelmingly backed Democrats and anti-AI/Big Tech positions, with restrictive data center ballot measures passing in nearly all 41 cases. The results signal a significant political shift that could lead to tougher regulation and infrastructure constraints for the AI industry.

articles.title: AI Companies Really, Really Want to Buy Your Work Files and Emails
articles.summary: Data brokers are collecting and selling internal corporate files and emails to AI companies to use as training data, often without employees' knowledge or consent. The practice raises major privacy and intellectual property concerns and is drawing scrutiny from businesses and policymakers.

articles.title: Data Center Delays Risk an ‘Air Gap’ for Chips: Lovell
articles.summary: UBS strategist Nadia Lovell warns that delays in data center construction could create an 'air gap' in semiconductor demand, pressuring chip inventories, prices, and margins. The analysis highlights how infrastructure bottlenecks could ripple through the AI hardware supply chain.

articles.title: Google Takes Over Wyoming Data Center That Crusoe Had Pitched
articles.summary: Google has acquired a data center site in Wyoming that AI computing startup Crusoe had previously pitched but failed to secure customers for, choosing to develop it directly. The move reflects hyperscalers' aggressive land-grab for AI computing infrastructure as demand for capacity intensifies.

articles.title: OpenAI Staffer Pleads Not Guilty to Office Bugging Charge
articles.summary: An OpenAI engineer has pleaded not guilty to federal charges of planting a hidden recording device in one of the company's offices. The case raises internal security and trust concerns at one of the world's leading AI labs.

articles.title: Low-profile Wall Street firm to double down on Anthropic despite tech rout
articles.summary: Wall Street investment firm XN has built a $5.3 billion stake in Anthropic through private-round investments and plans to increase its position despite the recent tech market downturn. This signals continued strong institutional confidence in frontier AI labs and provides Anthropic with a stable, well-capitalized long-term backer amid an intensifying AI race.

articles.title: DIGITIMES Insight: Cloud LLMs drive sharp increase in KV cache demand; establishes three key directions for SSD development
articles.summary: The rapid growth of cloud-based large language models is driving a sharp increase in demand for KV cache storage, pushing SSD development in three key new directions. This reflects how AI infrastructure requirements are reshaping the broader hardware and storage industry at the component level.

articles.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
articles.summary: OpenAI is partnering with bug bounty platform Hacktron to identify vulnerabilities in its systems, including connections with third-party services. The move reflects growing recognition that securing AI infrastructure requires proactive, external red-teaming and cybersecurity collaboration.

articles.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
articles.summary: ToyBlocks is a controlled simulated environment designed for robot learning and evaluation. Such benchmarking environments are essential for standardizing progress measurement in robotics AI research and enabling fair comparisons across systems.

articles.title: Meta’s Muse AI can create custom ‘spaces’ for the version of the app you need right now
articles.summary: Meta has introduced 'Spaces' within its Muse AI assistant, enabling users to build customized, app-like experiences such as shopping hubs, school dashboards, and trivia games directly within the assistant. The feature marks a significant expansion of Muse's utility as a platform for personalized AI-driven applications.

articles.title: Amazon will let you text Alexa your shopping list
articles.summary: Amazon is adding a text-based shopping feature to Alexa for Shopping, allowing customers to describe or photograph items and receive product recommendations via SMS. The update extends Alexa's AI commerce capabilities beyond voice, deepening Amazon's AI-driven retail ecosystem.

articles.title: “Does Meta think we can’t read?” Meta abandons sketchy commercial terms update.
articles.summary: Meta has reversed a proposed update to its commercial terms that would have required Facebook page owners to allow AI training on content linked from their pages, following widespread criticism. The retreat highlights ongoing tensions between AI companies' data needs and content creators' rights.

articles.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
articles.summary: Security researchers discovered hundreds of servers hosting the Artex AI-powered penetration testing tool left publicly exposed on the internet, giving anyone unauthorized access to the hacking tool. The finding underscores the dual-use risks of AI-enhanced offensive security tools and the dangers of misconfigured deployments.

articles.title: Analysis: Britain's semiconductor paradox—world-class innovation, but who captures the value?
articles.summary: Britain faces a structural paradox where it produces world-class semiconductor innovation but struggles to capture the resulting economic value domestically. This highlights a critical policy challenge for the UK in translating R&D strength into industrial and competitive advantage in the global chip race.

articles.title: 月之暗面放大招！Kimi Hosted Agents 正式发布
articles.summary: Moonshot AI (月之暗面) officially launched Kimi Hosted Agents on November 5, offering its Harness agent runtime framework as a managed cloud service to reduce the operational burden on developers building long-running and multi-agent AI applications. The release positions Kimi as a platform player in the rapidly growing AI agent infrastructure space.

articles.title: 淘宝MNN 团队开源 MNN-Pocket-0.3B，iPhone 18 Pro 离线解码飙升至 350 token/s
articles.summary: Taobao's MNN team open-sourced MNN-Pocket-0.3B, a 300M-parameter on-device language model achieving up to 350 tokens/second on iPhone 18 Pro with under 300MB peak memory. This advances the deployment of capable LLMs on consumer mobile hardware without cloud dependency.

articles.title: 4.7 万条假名人内容被清：网信办给 AI 换脸带货踩刹车
articles.summary: China's cyberspace regulator (CAC) announced the removal of over 47,000 pieces of illegal content and the handling of 3,961 accounts in a crackdown on AI-generated deepfakes impersonating celebrities for commerce, fraud, and low-quality content. The enforcement action underscores China's tightening regulatory grip on AI-generated synthetic media.

articles.title: 千亿级估值，十几亿收入，可灵AI能否支撑快手第二增长梦？ - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: Kuaishou's Kling AI video generation product, valued at over 100 billion yuan, is generating revenues in the billions of yuan but faces questions about whether it can truly anchor the platform's second growth curve. The analysis highlights the tension between sky-high AI valuations and still-nascent monetization in China's generative video market.

articles.title: Stockpiled in Hong Kong: Beijing limits Nvidia H200 imports as domestic silicon push accelerates
articles.summary: Beijing is restricting imports of Nvidia's H200 AI chips, reportedly stockpiled in Hong Kong, as China accelerates its push to develop domestic semiconductor alternatives. This move intensifies the US-China chip rivalry and pressures both Chinese AI developers and global chipmakers navigating export controls.

articles.title: AI短剧门槛降降降！实测即梦短剧工作室：剧本分镜预演一条龙，伙伴计划长期护航
articles.summary: China's Jimeng (即梦) has launched a short-drama studio tool that handles scriptwriting, storyboarding, and previsualization end-to-end, significantly lowering the barrier for AI-generated short video content. This reflects the rapid productization of generative AI for entertainment and content creation in the Chinese market.

articles.title: 用 AI 做 PPT 被开除，公司反赔 4.6 万：法院判了
articles.summary: A Beijing court ruled in favor of an insurance company employee who was fired for uploading internal data to a third-party AI platform to assist in making a PowerPoint presentation, ordering the company to pay ¥46,000 in compensation. The case sets a precedent for how workplace AI usage policies and information security rules interact with employee rights.

articles.title: 张朝阳首度直面错失移动互联网：大模型需要拼资源我们做不起，别被 AI 盲目带跑
articles.summary: Sohu founder Charles Zhang publicly admitted the company missed the mobile internet wave and explained that Sohu is deliberately avoiding aggressive investment in large AI models due to resource constraints. His remarks highlight how legacy Chinese internet companies are strategically cautious amid the AI race.

articles.title: Fourier’s Meta Prototype Puts a Spotlight on an 8-Billion-Yuan Robotics Bet
articles.summary: Shanghai-based Fourier Intelligence built a custom humanoid robot for Meta's internal research operations, showcasing its engineering capabilities alongside its disclosed ~8 billion yuan pre-money valuation. While the Meta partnership is a marquee signal, analysts note it validates technical credibility more than it justifies the equity story.

articles.title: Claude Code华人一姐，闪电跳槽到OpenAI，大厂为何留不住人才？
articles.summary: Catherine Wu (Cat Wu), the lead product executive behind Claude Code at Anthropic, announced her departure from Anthropic and near-simultaneously joined OpenAI to lead product management for a core product team. The rapid talent movement highlights fierce inter-lab competition for top AI product leaders.

articles.title: 工信部印发《关于加强智能体终端设备进网管理的通知》
articles.summary: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) issued a notice strengthening network access management for intelligent agent terminal devices. The regulation marks an important step in China's governance of AI-powered edge devices and agent-capable hardware.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
articles.summary: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire AI agent security startup Clutch for approximately $500 million, representing a roughly 6x step-up from Clutch's last known valuation of $85 million. The deal would signal major cybersecurity incumbents moving urgently to defend against and secure the growing attack surface created by autonomous AI agents.

articles.title: Democrats planning flood of AI bills when they take control of Congress - Reuters
articles.summary: Democratic lawmakers are preparing a large package of AI-related legislation to advance when they regain control of Congress. This signals a potential shift toward more active federal AI governance and could reshape the regulatory landscape for AI development and deployment in the US.

articles.title: Nvidia Boosts Chip Tracking in Southeast Asia to Fight Smuggling
articles.summary: Nvidia is intensifying tracking measures for AI chips sold in Southeast Asia to prevent smuggling to Chinese entities following criticism of inadequate enforcement. This move highlights ongoing geopolitical tensions around semiconductor export controls and the difficulty of enforcing US restrictions on advanced AI hardware.

articles.title: China's chip equipment makers ride record AI orders into 2027, but new challenges lie ahead
articles.summary: China's domestic chip equipment manufacturers are experiencing record AI-driven orders projected to extend into 2027, though they face emerging technical and geopolitical challenges. This growth reflects China's accelerating effort to build a self-sufficient semiconductor supply chain amid ongoing Western export restrictions.

articles.title: Tesla unveils AI accelerator roadmap, adopts new 'SI' branding in 'Super Intelligence' push
articles.summary: Tesla has revealed an AI accelerator roadmap featuring its Dojo D3 training chip and a large SI6 inference accelerator, rebranding its AI ambitions under a new 'Super Intelligence' (SI) identity. This signals Tesla's intent to compete directly in custom AI silicon, reducing reliance on third-party chips and potentially entering the broader AI infrastructure market.

articles.title: 99.4%登顶全球第一！这个中国AI师承世界冠军
articles.summary: A Chinese AI system has reportedly topped a global ranking with a 99.4% score, described as having learned from a world champion. The achievement signals continued competitive progress in Chinese AI benchmarking and specialized model training.

articles.title: AI开始收费，租号灰产崛起：一月流水30万
articles.summary: As major AI platforms shift to paid subscription models, a gray market for shared or rented AI accounts has emerged in China, with some operators reportedly generating ¥300,000 in monthly revenue. This black market reflects widespread price resistance among hundreds of millions of users and raises security and policy concerns for AI companies.

articles.title: Agent，“重做”数据库
articles.summary: AI agents are being applied to redesign database architectures, moving beyond simple storage toward systems that can semantically understand and reason over data. This represents a fundamental shift in how databases are built and queried in an agentic AI era.

articles.title: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
articles.summary: Physicl raised $10 million to close the sim-to-real gap for robotics by building synthetic data pipelines originally developed for e-commerce product visualization. The funding reflects growing investor interest in infrastructure that makes virtual training environments reliably transferable to physical robots.

articles.title: Microsoft’s Buyout Offer Sets Its Workforce on Edge
articles.summary: Microsoft has offered buyouts to approximately 60,000 employees as it redirects investment heavily toward artificial intelligence. This workforce restructuring reflects the broader industry trend of pivoting human capital and budgets away from legacy operations toward AI-driven priorities.

articles.title: A&O Shearman's $1.1 billion AI plan builds on law firms' tech investments - Reuters
articles.summary: Law firm A&O Shearman has announced a $1.1 billion AI investment plan, continuing a broader trend of major law firms integrating AI into legal services. This substantial commitment underscores how AI adoption is accelerating across professional services, with significant implications for legal industry workflows and competition.

articles.title: SK Hynix AI arm buys US$377 million stake in Penguin Solutions from SK Telecom
articles.summary: SK Hynix's AI subsidiary has acquired a $377 million stake in Penguin Solutions, formerly owned by SK Telecom, strengthening its position in AI infrastructure. This strategic investment reflects South Korean chipmakers' efforts to extend their influence across the broader AI hardware and solutions ecosystem.

articles.title: Samsung, SK Hynix eye AI inference boom as South Korea's SSD exports soar 584%
articles.summary: Samsung and SK Hynix are positioning to capitalize on the AI inference market surge, with South Korea's SSD exports rising a remarkable 584%. The explosive export growth underscores how AI inference workloads are driving unprecedented demand for high-performance memory and storage hardware.

articles.title: Nvidia wants to repurpose over 130 old telco buildings as tiny data centers, report claims
articles.summary: Nvidia is reportedly in talks to convert more than 130 former Brightspeed telecom buildings across the US into small-scale data centers, potentially generating up to 1GW of compute capacity. Repurposing existing infrastructure could help Nvidia rapidly expand AI compute availability while sidestepping lengthy new construction timelines.

articles.title: 准确率刷新行业上限，Pangram凭何接连攻克图像与视频AI检测难关?
articles.summary: Pangram Labs released Image1.0 and Image Flash1.0 models on November 4, achieving 99.96% accuracy in detecting AI-generated images and videos, using a test set derived from 12 leading image generators. These tools, which include heatmap localization of AI content, raise the bar for digital content authenticity verification.

articles.title: GPT-6.2 Astra与Claude 5. 5 新旗舰同日遭曝光，硅谷直接炸锅
articles.summary: Leaked or rumored details about GPT-6.2 Astra from OpenAI and Claude 5.5 from Anthropic surfaced simultaneously, causing significant excitement in Silicon Valley. If accurate, the concurrent next-generation flagship reveals signal an intensifying race between the two leading AI labs.

articles.title: 号称超级AI黑客！OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber正式登场
articles.summary: OpenAI has officially released GPT-6 Cyber, a model positioned as a highly capable AI cybersecurity agent. The launch signals OpenAI's direct entry into the AI-driven offensive and defensive cybersecurity tools market.

articles.title: 用轨迹自适应诱饵拖住、引开并化解自主渗透智能体
articles.summary: Researchers have proposed a trajectory-adaptive decoy system designed to lure, redirect, and neutralize autonomous AI penetration agents. The technique represents a novel defensive countermeasure specifically tailored to the emerging threat of AI-driven cyberattacks.

articles.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
articles.summary: AI startup Underdog demonstrated a compact 32MB model capable of generating both speech and music, punching well above its weight class in terms of output quality relative to model size. The achievement is significant for on-device and low-resource deployment of generative audio AI.

articles.title: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
articles.summary: A journalist in San Francisco tried a new humanoid robot cleaning service, documenting the experience as an early glimpse of domestic robotics becoming a commercial reality. The emergence of paid humanoid robot services signals that general-purpose robots are beginning to transition from labs to everyday consumer applications.

articles.title: 写 3 万行代码的不是他，是 AI：前谷歌工程师的"闲人"自白
articles.summary: Former Google engineer Wang Yonggang documented how Claude Opus 5.5 autonomously expanded a small open-source Altair 8800 emulator into a 30,000-line codebase—including an assembler, debugger, and teletype simulator—in just a few days. The account illustrates how AI coding agents are increasingly taking over substantial software development tasks from human engineers.

articles.title: 三星砸 42 亿建数据中心，算力的子弹先留给自己人
articles.summary: Samsung SDS broke ground on a new AI data center in Gumi, South Korea, with a footprint of approximately 46,300 square meters supporting next-generation GPU servers, primarily to serve Samsung Group's internal manufacturing robotics and AI workloads. The move reflects a trend of large conglomerates vertically integrating AI compute infrastructure rather than relying solely on cloud providers.

articles.title: Egyptian and Nigerian English join the Open ASR Leaderboard
articles.summary: Egyptian and Nigerian English language variants have been added to Hugging Face's Open ASR Leaderboard, expanding benchmarking coverage to underrepresented African and Middle Eastern English dialects. This matters for AI inclusivity as it creates accountability for speech recognition performance across diverse global English speakers.

articles.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
articles.summary: Australian universities are expanding institutional access to ChatGPT and integrating AI tools into curricula to produce graduates who are proficient in working alongside AI systems. This signals a broader shift in higher education toward treating AI fluency as a core graduate competency.

articles.title: 蚂蚁百灵发布 Ling 3.2 Flash：三项核心基准超越 Claude Opus 5，前两周限时免费开放
articles.summary: Ant Group's Bailing lab released Ling-3.2-Flash on November 6, a 560B native multimodal model that reportedly surpasses Claude Opus 5 on three core benchmarks, with two weeks of free access. The launch signals intensifying Chinese competition in frontier multimodal AI, directly challenging Anthropic and other Western labs.

articles.title: 20家大厂签约，AI操作App仍要过三道关
articles.summary: Twenty major Chinese tech companies have signed agreements to enable AI interoperability, but 155 apps still refuse to allow ByteDance's Doubao AI agent to operate within them. The standoff highlights the tension between open AI ecosystems and platform control in China's app economy.

articles.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
articles.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized cybersecurity model designed to identify exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes while staying within authorized operational boundaries. The launch marks a significant step in deploying aligned AI agents for offensive and defensive cybersecurity tasks.

articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: AI backlash could threaten Anthropic IPO timing, potential investors say - Reuters
articles.summary: Potential investors have told Reuters that growing public backlash against AI could jeopardize the timing of Anthropic's planned IPO. This signals that market sentiment toward AI is becoming a material financial risk factor for even well-funded frontier AI companies.

articles.title: 灵光做Personal Agent的痛点，小红书和Rokid想联手补上
articles.summary: Chinese platforms Xiaohongshu (RedNote) and Rokid are collaborating to address pain points in personal AI agents, combining their respective strengths in social content and AR hardware. The partnership illustrates how Chinese tech companies are experimenting with cross-platform agent integration to accelerate real-world AI utility.

articles.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
articles.summary: NVIDIA released Cosmos 3, a new set of open models designed for interactive world simulation. The release advances physically grounded world models relevant to robotics, autonomous vehicles, and embodied AI training.

articles.title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
articles.summary: Perplexity launched 'Teammates,' always-on AI agents for workplace use that can take on multiple roles, integrate with existing Perplexity tools, and operate via its computer-use system. The move puts Perplexity in direct competition with OpenAI and Anthropic in the rapidly expanding enterprise AI agent market.

articles.title: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
articles.summary: Anthropic launched a Personal Finance feature for Claude that connects directly to users' bank and card accounts via Plaid, enabling conversational financial analysis. The integration moves Claude beyond information retrieval into consequential real-world financial data access, raising both utility and safety considerations.

articles.title: India flags Chinese-linked AI tools in hacking campaign against financial firms - Reuters
articles.summary: India has flagged Chinese-linked AI tools being used in a hacking campaign targeting financial institutions, raising alarms about state-sponsored cyber operations leveraging AI. The incident highlights the growing use of AI as a vector for geopolitically motivated cyberattacks against critical financial infrastructure.

articles.title: Microsoft Sours on Neoclouds IREN, Nebius, Nscale on Delays, Costs
articles.summary: Microsoft is pulling back from contracts with neocloud data center operators like IREN, Nebius, and Nscale due to delays and rising costs, despite having helped fuel the neocloud boom. This retrenchment could disrupt the AI infrastructure supply chain and signal a cooling in Microsoft's aggressive capacity expansion strategy.

articles.title: US lawmakers summon Jensen Huang over Chinese spying concerns
articles.summary: Top Republican lawmakers have summoned Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to brief congressional committees following reports that he was targeted by Chinese intelligence through a compromised business contact. The move underscores bipartisan concern over Chinese espionage targeting America's most critical AI hardware company.

articles.title: AI backlash threatens trillion-dollar data centre boom, say tech leaders
articles.summary: Tech executives at the Financial Times' Future of AI summit acknowledged that the industry's own behavior has fueled public backlash that now threatens the trillion-dollar data center investment wave. Leaders admitted that a failure to manage community and environmental concerns has created political and reputational risks to AI expansion.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks in Talks to Pay $500 Million for AI Security Startup - The Information
articles.summary: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire an AI security startup for approximately $500 million. This signals growing corporate investment in AI-native cybersecurity solutions as enterprises seek integrated defenses against AI-driven threats.

articles.title: China Blocks SoftBank’s $5.4 Billion ABB Robotics Deal - The Information
articles.summary: China has blocked SoftBank's proposed $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB's robotics division, halting a major cross-border deal. The move underscores how geopolitical competition over robotics and advanced manufacturing technology is intensifying between China and Western-aligned investors.

articles.title: California Sends AI Safety Lawmaker to Congress - The Information
articles.summary: A California legislator known for championing AI safety bills has been elected to the U.S. Congress, bringing state-level AI policy experience to the federal stage. This marks a significant step in localizing Apple Intelligence for the Chinese market through vertical e-commerce partnerships.

articles.title: 【钛晨报】五部门最新部署：“一行一策”开展节能改造，加强原材料回收利用；字节限制外部AI工具访问内部资料？知情人士回应；倍轻松实控人被罚没1184万元、禁入证券市场5年
articles.summary: Huawei, Alibaba, and 18 other Chinese firms jointly announced a shared infrastructure initiative to interconnect AI agents across industries, while ByteDance reportedly restricted employee access to external AI tools for internal data. These moves reflect intensifying efforts to build sovereign AI ecosystems and tighten enterprise data security in China.

articles.title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
articles.summary: Meta has acquired Conductor, an AI coding startup that enables engineers to deploy multiple specialized agents simultaneously on different parts of a software project. The acquisition advances Meta's AI-assisted software development capabilities and reflects broader Big Tech competition for agentic coding tools.

articles.title: Months-Old Chip Startup Tenspresso in Talks for $500 Million Valuation
articles.summary: Tenspresso, a three-month-old AI chip startup founded by ex-Google engineers, is in talks to raise funding at a $500 million valuation. The deal reflects continued investor appetite for AI hardware alternatives even at very early stages, as competition in the chip design space intensifies.

articles.title: Arm Fails to Impress Investors With AI-Fueled Sales Forecast
articles.summary: Arm Holdings issued a revenue forecast that disappointed investors, indicating the company has not yet met elevated expectations for its AI data center push. The lukewarm outlook signals that transitioning Arm's architecture dominance from mobile to AI infrastructure remains a work in progress.

articles.title: Goldman, Apollo in Talks to Sell SpaceX’s $40 Billion AI Deal
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs and Apollo are working to syndicate portions of a ~$40 billion AI chip financing deal for SpaceX to Wall Street investors, amid political uncertainty following Democratic midterm gains. The deal highlights the intersection of AI infrastructure finance and geopolitical risk in the post-election environment.

articles.title: A One-Cent Livestream Does Not Make Office AI a Mass Habit
articles.summary: Alibaba promoted its Qwen Office productivity suite via a heavily discounted livestream event featuring a top influencer, generating buzz but leaving the real adoption test for when pricing normalizes. The campaign highlights the gap between marketing spectacle and sustained enterprise AI habit formation.

articles.title: AI PACs spent millions trying to shape Congress — here’s how they fared
articles.summary: AI industry PACs spent millions attempting to influence the 2026 US midterm elections but achieved mixed results, with political groups already planning for 2028. The outcome suggests that AI industry political spending has not yet translated into reliable electoral influence.

articles.title: AMD's record quarter: Data center business doubles, while gaming craters
articles.summary: AMD reported a record $13.4 billion quarter driven by a doubling of data center revenue, even as its gaming segment fell 40%. The results reinforce the AI data center boom as the primary growth engine for semiconductor companies, while consumer gaming markets continue to weaken.

articles.title: Exclusive: Microsoft Lowered Data Center Spending Following Delays By Cloud Firm Iren - The Information
articles.summary: Microsoft reduced its data center capital spending after delays by cloud infrastructure firm Iren pushed back project timelines. The pullback suggests that supply-chain and partner execution risks are beginning to temper the pace of hyperscaler AI infrastructure buildout.

articles.title: Introducing Images 2.6
articles.summary: OpenAI launched Images 2.6, bringing faster generation, GIF creation, more precise editing tools, and expanded API controls across ChatGPT and Codex. The update strengthens OpenAI's position in the competitive AI image generation market by improving both speed and developer flexibility.

articles.title: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink
articles.summary: Qualcomm is pivoting toward AI data center markets as smartphone sales fell roughly 20% year-over-year, announcing partnerships with Amazon and Meta to establish its data center presence. The strategic shift signals a broader industry realignment as mobile chip makers seek growth in AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Apple is reportedly cutting budgets for its internal AI usage
articles.summary: Apple is reportedly cutting internal AI spending for its engineering teams, reducing budgets for AI tools used in development workflows. The move raises questions about the gap between Apple's public AI ambitions and its internal cost discipline.

articles.title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says
articles.summary: Uber disclosed that during its busiest week last quarter, only four customers booked rides through AI agents, underscoring the vast gap between AI agent hype and actual consumer adoption. The data serves as a reality check for predictions about agentic AI rapidly transforming everyday commerce.

articles.title: OpenAI is already trying to shape the 2028 election
articles.summary: OpenAI's policy chief Chris Lehane is positioning the company to shape the 2028 US election cycle, proposing AI-centric policy frameworks that align public benefit narratives with OpenAI's commercial interests. The move signals that AI companies are becoming active participants in long-term political strategy.

articles.title: Big Tech claims voters’ AI backlash is “anti-Trump” not “anti-tech”
articles.summary: US voters in the 2026 midterms broadly supported measures restricting AI and data center expansion, but the tech industry is characterizing the backlash as politically motivated rather than technology-specific. The divergence between industry spin and voter behavior highlights a deepening public skepticism toward AI development.

articles.title: Cerebras’ Lockups Hold a Lesson for Anthropic Employees - The Information
articles.summary: Cerebras' IPO lockup experience is being cited as a cautionary lesson for Anthropic employees regarding liquidity timelines and the risks of paper wealth in pre-IPO AI companies. This matters as it highlights the financial realities facing employees at high-valued AI startups, potentially affecting talent retention and compensation strategies across the sector.

articles.title: DevRev delivers autonomous self-service with GPT-6.1 Sol
articles.summary: DevRev integrated OpenAI's GPT-4.1 (marketed as GPT-6.1 Sol) to power autonomous customer service agents called Computer and Operator, optimizing the balance between reasoning quality, speed, and cost. This deployment illustrates the growing adoption of frontier models in enterprise agentic workflows.

articles.title: Empyrean's EDA acquisitions could give Korean chip designers cheaper tools—and stronger Chinese rivals
articles.summary: China-based Empyrean Technology's acquisitions in EDA tooling could provide Korean chip designers with more affordable design software while simultaneously strengthening Chinese competitors' capabilities. This development raises geopolitical concerns about technology access and competitive balance in the global semiconductor design ecosystem.

articles.title: After the midterms, a bigger clash over data centers could be coming
articles.summary: Opposition to data center construction emerged as a bipartisan issue in the 2026 US midterm elections, suggesting that community resistance to AI infrastructure is broadening beyond any single political constituency. This could complicate future siting and permitting for the data centers underpinning AI growth.

articles.title: Airoha targets multibillion growth as 100G ramps, 200G tapes out
articles.summary: Airoha Technology is targeting multibillion-dollar revenue growth as 100G networking products ramp up and 200G solutions reach tape-out stage. This signals accelerating demand for high-speed networking chips critical to AI data center infrastructure.

articles.title: DIGITIMES Insight: TSMC, ASML's 2031 photomask target puts High NA EUV suppliers on the clock
articles.summary: TSMC and ASML have set a 2031 target for advanced photomask technology tied to High NA EUV lithography, placing pressure on photomask suppliers to meet an aggressive development timeline. This milestone is critical for sustaining semiconductor scaling roadmaps that underpin next-generation AI chip manufacturing.

articles.title: 百度无人车搞出“黑客帝国”！世界模型实时推演全局，跑一天抵三年

This advancement could dramatically accelerate the training and safety validation of self-driving AI systems.

articles.title: Nvidia Tells Cloud Clients to Take on Less China Business - The Information
articles.summary: Nvidia is reportedly advising its cloud clients to reduce their business exposure to China, likely in anticipation of tightening US export restrictions. This move highlights how geopolitical tensions continue to shape the AI chip supply chain and cloud provider strategies.

articles.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
articles.summary: OpenAI is acquiring Pierre Computer Company to expand the capabilities of its Codex platform for building, understanding, and reviewing code. This move deepens OpenAI's push into AI-assisted software development tools and strengthens its competitive position against GitHub Copilot and other coding assistants.

articles.summary: Voters in the 2026 US midterm elections backed candidates supporting moratoriums and restrictions on data center construction, with 76% of NBC News-polled Election Day voters expressing opposition to unchecked expansion. This political shift threatens a core pillar of AI infrastructure buildout in the United States.

articles.title: AI models can tinker with one another’s brains
articles.summary: Researchers have demonstrated that AI models can modify each other's internal parameters, enabling one model to 'tinker with' another's weights in relatively small-scale experiments. This finding raises important questions for AI safety and alignment, as it suggests models could potentially manipulate one another's behavior.

articles.title: US bank regulator issues first-ever AI guidance for examiners - Reuters
articles.summary: The US bank regulator has issued its first-ever AI guidance for examiners, establishing a framework for how AI use in banking will be assessed. This marks a significant policy milestone that could set precedents for AI oversight across the financial sector.

articles.title: The Security Companies Trying to Get AI Agents Under Control - The Information
articles.summary: Security companies are developing tools and frameworks to control the behavior of AI agents, which pose unique risks due to their autonomy and ability to take real-world actions. This emerging market reflects growing concern that agentic AI systems require specialized security guardrails beyond traditional software protections.

articles.title: Apollo Is Vastly Outspending the Neoclouds on AI Chips - The Information
articles.summary: Apollo Global is spending far more on AI chips than neocloud competitors, signaling that traditional private equity and asset management firms are aggressively entering the AI infrastructure race. This shift could reshape who controls critical AI compute resources and intensify competition with established cloud providers.

articles.title: Uber only fulfilled 4 rides from AI agents last quarter
articles.summary: Uber disclosed that only four rides were arranged by third-party AI agents during Q3 2026, with roughly 500 Uber Eats orders fulfilled by agents during the same period. The figures suggest that despite hype, AI agent-driven commerce remains nascent and far from disrupting established platform businesses.

articles.title: Open source AI is booming. Hugging Face explains who profits.
articles.summary: Hugging Face examines the booming open source AI ecosystem and how companies capture value as capable models become freely available, while Chinese open models increasingly challenge American players. The discussion highlights strategic tensions between openness, commercialization, and geopolitical competition in AI.

articles.title: Google faces backlash for plan that would turn off Search for schools that restrict AI
articles.summary: Google faces political backlash from officials including NYC mayor Zohran Mamdani and former FTC chair Lina Khan over its plan to disable Search for schools that restrict AI Overviews, with critics calling it monopolistic coercion. This controversy intensifies regulatory scrutiny of Google's bundling practices in the education sector.

articles.title: Texas was the new epicenter of the AI data center buildout. That might be kaput.
articles.summary: Texas's dominant position as the fastest-growing US data center market may be jeopardized after a Democratic wave in the 2026 midterms brought candidates to power who are likely to impose stricter regulations on AI infrastructure development. This political shift could redirect billions in Big Tech investment to other states.

articles.title: Hugging Face’s CEO Says His P(Doom) Is ‘Close to Zero’
articles.summary: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue stated his probability of AI-caused doom is 'close to zero,' arguing that existential risk is primarily driven by a few closed-door developers rather than the open source ecosystem. His comments frame open source AI as a safety and transparency measure against concentrated AI power.

articles.title: UK Officials Said AI Would Add £400 Billion to the Economy. That Figure Mainly Came From Google
articles.summary: UK officials have walked back claims that AI would add £400 billion to the economy, with the AI minister now conceding the figure is less than a third of that original estimate, which researchers say was largely sourced from Google. The revision highlights the risks of governments relying on industry-provided data to shape AI policy.

articles.title: OpenAI’s approach to mathematics does not add up
articles.summary: Two months after OpenAI announced advances in mathematical reasoning, the company continues to face criticism for a lack of transparency about its methodology and results. Critics argue this opacity undermines scientific reproducibility and trust in AI benchmarks, with significant implications for how progress in AI is evaluated.

articles.title: South Korea's Lee vows to make bold AI investment in record budget push - Reuters
articles.summary: South Korean President Lee pledged bold AI investment as part of a record national budget push, signaling the government's commitment to competing in the global AI race. This reflects the growing trend of nations treating AI investment as a core economic and strategic priority.

articles.title: CoreWeave Bonds Hit New Lows as Texas Data Centers in Crosshairs
articles.summary: CoreWeave's bonds fell to new lows after Democratic candidates who favor slowing data-center construction won key gubernatorial races, including in Texas. This signals that political headwinds around data-center expansion could materially affect AI infrastructure financing and growth.

articles.title: Bill Gates: AI bioweapons ‘could be worse than Covid’
articles.summary: Bill Gates warned that AI-enabled bioweapons could cause a pandemic worse than Covid, calling for stronger government oversight of AI. His remarks highlight escalating concern among prominent tech figures about catastrophic AI misuse risks.

articles.title: Samsung to reportedly make AMD, Nvidia HBM base dies at second Texas fab
articles.summary: Samsung is reportedly planning to manufacture HBM base dies for AMD and Nvidia at a second Texas fabrication facility, expanding its role in supplying high-bandwidth memory critical for AI chips. This move could help Samsung gain a larger share of the booming AI hardware supply chain.

articles.title: Global chip sales top US$500 billion in a single quarter for first time
articles.summary: Global chip sales surpassed US$500 billion in a single quarter for the first time, a record driven largely by AI-related demand for GPUs, HBM, and other advanced semiconductors. This milestone underscores the transformative economic impact AI is having on the global semiconductor industry.

articles.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
articles.summary: Daybreak Red's GPT-5.6 Cyber AI model is now available to authorized customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) via Amazon Bedrock for cybersecurity applications. This deployment marks a significant step in bringing advanced AI capabilities into government-approved secure cloud environments for offensive and defensive cyber operations.

articles.title: ChatGPT will now make you animated GIFs

articles.title: Amazon's US$2 billion Ohio data center plan faces new hurdle as voters approve ban
articles.summary: Amazon's planned US$2 billion data center in Ohio faces a new obstacle after local voters approved a ban that could block the project. This reflects growing community-level resistance to large-scale AI infrastructure development, echoing similar political dynamics seen in Texas.

articles.title: Nothing teases a screen-free AI device ahead of launch next month
articles.summary: Nothing CEO Carl Pei announced the company's first AI hardware device will launch in December, teasing a screen-free form factor roughly a year after announcing plans for AI-native devices. articles.title: DuckDuckGo pitches itself to schools amid backlash over Google’s AI policy
articles.summary: DuckDuckGo is actively courting schools frustrated by Google's decision to bundle AI Overviews with its search product, offering its privacy-focused search engine as an alternative with options to disable AI features. This positions DuckDuckGo to gain institutional ground in the education market amid growing concerns about AI in classrooms.

articles.title: What’s next for US energy policy after the midterm elections?

This political realignment is expected to reshape regulations governing AI data center energy consumption and broader infrastructure investment.

articles.title: Gemini for Home now plugs into AT&T’s smart security system
articles.summary: AT&T has integrated Google's Gemini for Home into its Connected Life smart home security system, enabling AI-powered features like event summarization and video history search. This marks the first home security product to integrate with Google Home Premium, illustrating growing adoption of generative AI in consumer IoT applications.

articles.title: Drones don’t just blow up the enemy
articles.summary: Military drones are being used not only for kinetic strikes but also for signals intelligence, intercepting radio transmissions to identify and geolocate future targets. This dual-use capability underscores the growing role of AI-enabled autonomous systems in modern electronic warfare and targeting pipelines.

articles.title: Former Intel packaging chief Navid Shahriari joins MediaTek as senior vice president
articles.summary: Navid Shahriari, former head of packaging at Intel, has joined MediaTek as a senior vice president, bringing deep expertise in advanced chip packaging to the Taiwanese semiconductor firm. articles.title: Tencent Declares Latest AI Model Ranks Among China’s Best

articles.summary: DeepSeek is reportedly planning to train its V5 model on Huawei's Ascend 950 chips by 2027, potentially reducing China's dependence on Nvidia hardware. articles.title: Google to Spend $15 Billion in Malaysia Data Center Expansion
articles.summary: Google announced a $15 billion investment to expand data center and cloud infrastructure in Malaysia, driven by surging AI demand. This signals continued hyperscaler commitment to Southeast Asian digital infrastructure as global competition for AI compute capacity intensifies.

articles.summary: Chinese robotics sector fundraising dropped sharply to approximately $1.6 billion in October, signaling a cooldown after a period of intense investment enthusiasm. articles.title: AI data centers comprehensively defeated at US midterm elections — 45 measures put on the ballot as Americans overwhelmingly vote against developments
articles.summary: Approximately 45 ballot measures related to AI data center development were put before American voters in midterm elections, with the majority voting against new developments in their communities. This reflects the financial sector's heightened caution about data exposure and control risks as agentic AI systems proliferate.

articles.title: Google hasn’t figured out how to make AI pay like its search engine
articles.summary: Google reported its fastest search query growth in five years, but Search revenue growth slowed to 12% year-over-year in Q3 from 17% the prior quarter, with paid click growth also decelerating—suggesting AI is driving usage without proportional ad monetization. This reveals a structural challenge for Google in converting AI-enhanced search into ad revenue, threatening its core business model.

articles.title: Securing the agentic enterprise with data lineage
articles.summary: An analysis of agentic enterprise AI systems highlights how multi-agent workflows—such as AI pulling from restricted data sources without human review—create serious data lineage and governance gaps. The piece argues that tracking data provenance is essential to securing AI agents operating across enterprise systems.

articles.title: 普林斯顿AI Lab推出SSoN基准，人类准确率83.3%而大模型最高仅39.7%
articles.summary: Princeton University's AI Lab introduced the SSoN benchmark for static 3D spatial reasoning, where humans scored 83.3% accuracy while top vision-language models reached only 39.7%—below random baseline for many. The results expose a critical gap in current AI spatial understanding capabilities with implications for robotics and autonomous systems.

articles.title: Seedance海外收入占比达50%，半年增长近5倍
articles.summary: ByteDance's video generation model Seedance has grown its overseas revenue to 50% of total income, with international markets growing nearly fivefold in six months, driven by copyright compliance deals including an MOU with the MPA and a Disney-TikTok content partnership. This signals that Chinese AI video generation tools are successfully penetrating global markets by proactively addressing intellectual property concerns.

articles.title: 苹果 AI 加速进入中国市场，Siri、视觉智能整合千问

articles.title: 实测：灵光和Today AI，谁才是中国版Muse？

The evaluation highlights the competitive domestic Chinese market for AI-driven creative applications and the race to localize frontier model capabilities.

articles.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity

This addresses growing concerns about AI impersonation and model identity fraud, with significant implications for trust and safety in AI deployments.

articles.title: Canva Announces Layoffs, Job Changes for About 22% of Workforce

articles.title: Super Micro Boosts Sales Forecast on AI-Fueled Server Demand

articles.title: AMD Forecast Exceeds Estimates as AI Chip Demand Soars

articles.title: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
articles.summary: European residential real estate company Heimstaden deployed OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to automate property management workflows, reducing costs and enabling non-technical employees to build internal tools. articles.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani spoke to WIRED about concerns that AI data centers impose community risks—including energy and environmental burdens—while profits flow elsewhere, and outlined his stance on AI in schools. articles.title: NVIDIA CEO and Sweden's Technology Leaders Discuss Compute's Next Chapter

articles.summary: Google expanded its AI storytelling experiment Dreambeans to India with support for 13 local languages, aiming to bring AI-generated personal narratives to a mass audience. articles.summary: China's memory chipmakers reported continued growth into the third quarter, even as risks from excess capacity and policy uncertainty mount. articles.title: Anthropic Reveals $17 Billion in Revenue as I.P.O. Approaches

articles.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI

articles.summary: Chinese AI companies DeepSeek and Moonshot reportedly used OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra model to help train their latest AI systems, according to The Information. articles.title: Anthropic Taps Macquarie, CommSec for Australia IPO Retail Offer

articles.title: 蚂蚁数科携「智能体超级工厂」亮相香港金融科技周，全新发布KYA方案

articles.title: Driven by A.I. Boom, Marvell and Lumentum Announce $115 Billion Merger

articles.title: China's robot makers have mastered the moves. Now comes the race for brains - Reuters
articles.summary: Chinese robotics manufacturers have achieved advanced physical capabilities in their robots but are now competing intensely to develop superior AI 'brains' to make them truly autonomous. articles.title: Abu Dhabi's ADNOC, G42 sign deal with OpenAI as Sam Altman travels to UAE - Reuters
articles.summary: Abu Dhabi's ADNOC and G42 signed an AI partnership deal with OpenAI during Sam Altman's visit to the UAE, deepening the Gulf state's ties with leading US AI firms. articles.title: Exclusive: Salesforce Acquires Startup Cresta for $2.7 Billion - The Information
articles.summary: Salesforce has agreed to acquire AI-powered contact center startup Cresta for $2.7 billion, bolstering its enterprise AI and customer service capabilities. The acquisition reflects the rapid consolidation of applied AI startups into major enterprise software platforms.

articles.title: Exclusive: OpenAI Sign Deals With Magnite, PubMatic to Fill Unused ChatGPT Ad Space - The Information
articles.summary: OpenAI has struck deals with ad tech firms Magnite and PubMatic to sell advertising against unused inventory in ChatGPT, marking a significant step toward monetizing its consumer AI platform through ads. articles.title: AI Subscriptions Hit a Wall as Smarter Models Burn Quotas Faster
articles.summary: As frontier AI models become more capable, they consume users' fixed monthly token quotas faster, creating structural tension between flat-fee subscription economics and rapidly improving model performance, as illustrated by Moonshot's Kimi triggering subscriber backlash. This pricing model mismatch poses a significant challenge to sustainable AI subscription business models industry-wide.

articles.title: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization
articles.summary: OpenAI appointed Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization to advise on responsible AI deployment for national security, cyber resilience, and allied collaboration. articles.title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas
articles.summary: OpenAI announced its Grid Protectors Program, piloting at a new Georgia data center where it will release up to 1,000 megawatts of power during grid emergencies, equivalent to powering air conditioning for roughly 700,000 homes. The initiative is a strategic effort to counter growing community opposition to energy-intensive AI data centers.

articles.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
articles.summary: Trajectory, a one-year-old startup, raised $45 million at a $300 million valuation to make AI model training accessible to non-technical business users. The funding reflects strong investor appetite for tools that democratize AI development beyond data science specialists.

articles.title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
articles.summary: 42AI emerged from stealth with $62.5 million in funding, unveiling a 'world model' it claims can predict human behavior even in novel situations the model has never encountered. articles.title: Claude’s new rules against game cloning won’t stop the AI copying boom
articles.summary: Anthropic's new Claude policy restricting game cloning is unlikely to meaningfully curb the broader wave of AI-generated copycat apps and games flooding the market. articles.title: Law firm's AI use doesn't warrant cutting legal fees, US appeals court rules - Reuters
articles.summary: A US appeals court ruled that a law firm's use of AI does not justify reducing its legal fees, establishing an early precedent on how courts view AI-assisted legal work. The decision is significant for the legal industry and broader questions about how AI productivity gains are valued and compensated.

articles.title: Chinese and Russian AI cyber attacks will be routine by 2028, says GCHQ
articles.summary: GCHQ's National Cyber Security Centre is warning that AI-enabled cyberattacks from China and Russia will become routine by 2028, with current defenses—especially for critical infrastructure—deemed inadequate. The forecast underscores the urgency for governments and industry to upgrade cybersecurity capabilities in the face of state-sponsored AI threats.

articles.title: How Smugglers Get Expensive Memory Chips to China from South Korea - The Information
articles.summary: Smugglers are reportedly moving high-bandwidth memory chips from South Korea to China, circumventing US-led export controls. The revelations highlight the difficulty of enforcing semiconductor restrictions and China's determination to access advanced chips despite geopolitical barriers.

articles.title: DIGITIMES Insight: Intel's retreat from low-margin industrial chips opens edge AI market to AMD and Arm rivals
articles.summary: Intel's withdrawal from low-margin industrial chip segments is creating market openings for AMD and Arm-based competitors in the edge AI space, according to Digitimes analysis. This shift could accelerate the diversification of the edge AI chip ecosystem away from Intel's historical dominance.

articles.title: OpenAI considers rebranding data centers to 'AI compute campuses" as data center backlash intensifies
articles.summary: OpenAI is promoting the term 'AI compute campuses' as a rebranding strategy for its data centers amid growing public backlash over electricity demand, water consumption, pollution, and rising utility costs. This signals that AI infrastructure is becoming a significant political and public relations liability, prompting the company to prepare a coordinated policy push ahead of the 2028 election cycle.

The competition demonstrates advancing capabilities of legged robots in complex, real-world terrain navigation.

articles.title: LifeVal

The benchmark shifts evaluation focus from abstract reasoning to real-world utility and societal impact of AI assistants.

articles.title: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
articles.summary: Agentic AI is being deployed in enterprise analytics to automate workflows, but current systems struggle to generate sufficiently high-quality insights. This quality gap represents a key barrier to realizing the full productivity and decision-making potential of autonomous AI agents in business settings.

articles.title: Coming in 2027: Apple’s $1,000 home robot for FaceTime and switching on lights
articles.summary: Apple is reportedly planning to launch a home robot around 2027, priced at approximately $1,000, with backing from CEO John Ternus but limited initial functionality such as FaceTime support and basic smart-home controls. articles.title: NVIDIA CEO and Sweden's Technology Leaders Discuss Compute's Next Chapter
articles.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang met with Swedish technology leaders to discuss the future of computing infrastructure, likely including AI data center expansion in the Nordic region. articles.summary: OpenAI engineering team detailed Pando, a custom Git-compatible backend built to handle the massive scale of code development enabled by its Codex AI coding system. articles.summary: Qodo integrated its AI code review platform with OpenAI's Codex to incorporate company-specific coding standards and repository context into automated pull request reviews. articles.summary: Elon Musk announced throttling of Grok Bot's usage limits due to unsustainably high operational costs, even as he described it as the fastest-growing product he has ever seen. articles.title: Data centers are now a midterm issue, even in Brooklyn
articles.summary: At a Brooklyn midterm election event, conversations among residents and a local council member repeatedly returned to AI and data centers as salient political concerns, suggesting the technology is becoming a mainstream electoral issue. The shift indicates that AI infrastructure policy is moving beyond tech industry circles into broader civic and political discourse.

articles.title: How A.I. Is Making It Easier Than Ever to Microtarget Voters
articles.summary: AI tools are enabling political campaigns to craft hyper-personalized voter outreach messages at unprecedented scale and precision. This development raises serious concerns about AI-powered disinformation and the integrity of democratic processes.

articles.title: SK Hynix ramps up SOCAMM2 as material shortages push up PCB prices
articles.summary: SK Hynix is ramping up production of SOCAMM2 memory modules as material shortages drive up printed circuit board prices. Supply chain constraints in advanced memory components could create bottlenecks for AI server deployments that depend on high-bandwidth memory.

articles.title: Samsung reportedly in talks with Nidec to develop robot motors

articles.title: FuriosaAI raises US$620 million, quadruples valuation to challenge Nvidia

articles.title: Qwen on China’s iPhones Is Less About Cloud Tokens Than Checkout

articles.title: Altman Says AI Will Transform the Economics of Energy

articles.title: ‘Control and sovereignty’ to shape UK approach to AI

articles.title: The race to keep AI under control
